name: Baby
description_html:
Baby arrived with two other small dogs, Sarge 30825 and Angel 30826.

Baby has needed some extra time to adapt to new scary-to-her, noisy surroundings. Staff and volunteers take things gently and slowly with her, at her pace, and she very much appreciates that.

We're starting to see her true self - she loves being a part time lap dog and receiving all the light petting, occasionally seeking out more from her surroundings that tells us she's ready to look toward her next adventures and might love to have small dog friends again at home.

If you are ready to offer your tenderness and compassion to help smooth over the future for a kind little lady who wants to fit in, she can use your help. She's 13 lbs, vaccinated, spayed, and heart worm negative. Ask staff while onsite to meet her.

name: Sarge
description_html:
Sarge arrived with two other small dogs, Angel 30826.and Baby 30827.

Sarge has done well adjusting to the noisy shelter but he's ready to pack his bags and get back to home living and might love to have small dog friends again at home.

Sarge is 20lbs and has been great for his veterinary procedures.

He's neutered, vaccinated and heart worm negative and RTG - ready to go home today.

Come meet him and see if he's "the one" you've been waiting for.

name: Marketa
description_html:
💗 Meet Marketa


Marketa arrived at the shelter very scared, which is completely understandable given all the new sights, sounds, and handling.


But we know there’s a sweet girl underneath it all. The person who found her said she was friendly in their home and allowed handling—she just needs time to feel safe again. 


Marketa is looking for a calm, patient home where she can relax and show her true personality.🏡🐱

name: Junie
description_html:
Meet Junie!


Junie has been loving and gentle since the moment she arrived, and she’s now hoping someone will see past a potential medical concern and see her.


Her left eye shows corneal pigmentation. It does not appear to be causing her pain or discomfort, but we recommend a future veterinary check-up, as eye conditions can sometimes change over time. Junie just needs someone willing to love her and keep an eye on her health. ❤️


If you’re looking for a sweet companion and have room in your heart for a truly special girl, please come meet Junie. 🐾

name: David
description_html:
💙 David needs a safe, indoor home. 🐾


Life on the streets of Austin hasn’t been kind to him—he has a history of injuries, and now he deserves comfort, safety, and love. 🏡💙


David is a sweet, cuddly boy who enjoys pets and is easy to handle. He even did well around large dogs! 🐶❤️ He does need to be an only cat, and like many cats, he can get overstimulated —so he needs someone who can read his signals and give him space when needed.


He’s not perfect, but he’s loving, affectionate, and ready for a fresh start with someone who sees past his rough past. David is ready to finally be safe, warm, and loved. 💙🐱

name: Winky
description_html:
Meet Winky! ✨


This handsome boy is laid-back, friendly, and super photogenic—he knows exactly how to strike a pose! 📸


Winky isn’t looking for a modeling career…he’s looking for a forever home. Come meet Winky and see if this charming boy is your perfect match!

name: Diesel
description_html:
Diesel loves everyone, he's great with people, kids and dogs but says "no siree" to cats! He has nice active energy for play and loves walks, playing with squeaky toys & balls, and playing with other dogs.

He was just tested in playgroups at the shelter and was very polite with playful greets. He engaged in soft play with the dogs most of the session. He's sharing space with a kennel friend now.

He's very house trained and knows the verbal cues.

Diesel has so much to offer that makes him an easy drop into a new home.


A common question - why is this dog here? Diesel is a native of Oregon who relocated with his people to Austin and lived in a condo with a beagle friend. Unfortunate housing circumstances dealt the family a setback.

name: Flora
description_html:
🌸 Flora is ready for her fresh start! 


Flora came in as a stray, but she was already spayed—so she was likely once someone’s beloved pet. Now she’s ready for a new beginning. 💔➡️💕


She’s a sweet, affectionate girl who loves people and attention, and she’s also very playful—especially with wand toys! Flora would do best as your one and only cat, where she can soak up all the love and attention she deserves. 👑 She’s ready for her forever home—could it be with you? 🏡💗

name: Dylan
description_html:
🐾💙 Dylan & Daniel are looking for a forever home — together! 💙🐾


These sweet brothers are a bonded pair who love to play, cuddle, and keep each other company. 

Surrendered when their owner moved somewhere that didn’t allow cats, they’re now hoping for a second chance at a loving home. They are friendly, cuddly, high-energy boys who LOVE toys — and they truly thrive together.


Dylan and Daniel (31147) are looking for a home where they can stay side by side. 💕🐱🐱


Two cats. One bond. Double the love.

name: Augie
description_html:
💙 Meet Augie—a scared boy with a sweet heart. 


When Augie first arrived, he was terrified—crouched low with huge eyes. But he never showed aggression, just fear.


Now we’re starting to see glimpses of the real Augie. 🥹 When volunteers approach, he sometimes rolls over and starts making biscuits—a hopeful little sign that he’s trying to trust. He’s still shy and wary of hands, but he’s making progress every day.


Augie needs a patient adopter who will let him go at his own pace and help him learn that people are safe. He’s scared. He’s trying. And he deserves someone who will believe in him.

name: Pickle
description_html: Pickle is a sweet, curious little guy with a friendly personality and lots of interest in the world around him! He has done wonderfully with my two-year-old cat, Maverick, and enjoys having a feline friend around. Pickle is litter-box trained and has been a great little houseguest. He’s affectionate, social, and always ready to investigate whatever is going on. Pickle would make a wonderful addition to a loving home looking for a sweet and curious companion!

name: Ember
description_html:
Meet Ember 🧡


Sweet Ember arrived with her two adorable tabby kittens and has been a loving, devoted mom. She is a young, friendly cat who enjoys affection and human company.


Now that her kittens are ready for their own homes, Ember is ready for a life of her own—filled with cozy indoor comforts, soft beds, and plenty of love.


If you're looking for a sweet, gentle companion, Ember is ready to meet you!

At first glance, you will likely notice Vlad’s gorgeous all-black coat, but his purr-sonality is even more priceless!


He may be perceived as shy when first meeting him, but he desperately wants to be around you. Vlad’s favorite way to show affection toward his human companions is by sitting on their lap or laying on their chest, purring loudly, making biscuits on their face, and licking their nose. Vlad LOVES noses so much that he sometimes cannot help but give them a little nibble. We are working to deter this by making a “tss!” sound when the teeth come out and he is starting to understand. 


Despite his affinity for lounging in your lap and on your chest, Vlad is still learning to be held. At times, he can be picked up like a baby and given pets, but sometimes he will struggle a bit. Interestingly, he will push against you while attempting to escape your grasp, but he does not use his claws. Once back on solid ground, he sometimes gives a single hiss, but then immediately continues seeking full-body pets (yes - belly too!) and play. 


Even quirkier than his obsession with noses, Vlad is an extraordinarily chatty man who likes the sound of his own voice, even when he doesn’t need anything. We joke that he is exploring his space through echolocation. 


When his humans aren’t around, Vlad usually lounges on the bed, showing off the rich brown color his coat becomes when illuminated by sunlight. 


Vlad has excellent bathroom manners, takes diligent care of his coat, and does not have any observed health concerns. He will be neutered on Wednesday 08/05 and will then be available for adoption! 


Vlad has shown playful interest in our resident cats, but he has not been introduced to them. We believe he would benefit from the company of another young cat. Because he’s so loving, we do think Vlad may be good with older children, but likely only those that can understand a little nibble. 


Please reach out if you are interested in Vlad!

name: Barbara
description_html:
Barbara’s life changed suddenly when her beloved owner passed away, and she and her sister Meredith Grey came to the shelter with no family able to take them in.😔


Unlike her outgoing sister, Barbara is more reserved and takes time to warm up to new people. But she’s already starting to come out of her shell, showing a gentle, sweet nature beneath her shy exterior.

She will thrive in a calm home where she can feel safe and settle in at her own pace. Meredith Gray has been adopted, so now Barbara is waiting for her turn.


If you have a soft spot for shy cats, Barbara is ready for a second chance at love and security. 💖🏡

name: Petunia
description_html:
Petunia is the kind of dog who wants to be everyone's friend. She loves people and is always hoping someone will stop to give her a few pets. Her sweet, social personality makes it easy to fall in love with her.


She appears to be housetrained, walks well on an Easy Walk harness with only mild pulling, and enjoys taking her time sniffing and exploring on walks. Petunia is curious about both people and other dogs and greets the world with friendly enthusiasm. She also has a playful side and would thrive with a family that can include her in everyday adventures.


If you're looking for an affectionate companion who loves to cuddle, enjoys being around people, and is ready for her forever home, Petunia is waiting to meet you.

name: Beau
description_html:
Beau is the kind of dog who makes it easy to fall in love. This sweet boy is a loose-leash walker who enjoys taking his time to sniff and explore the world around him. He seems housetrained and has a gentle, affectionate nature—he's happiest when he's getting pets and soaking up all the love you have to give.


While Beau can be barrier reactive in his kennel when other dogs pass by, he showed a completely different side once outside, calmly ignoring other dogs on his walk. Shelter life can be stressful, but out in the open he's an easygoing companion who just wants to enjoy a nice stroll and spend time with his people.


If you're looking for a cuddly, loving best friend who enjoys leisurely walks and plenty of affection, Beau may be the perfect match!

name: Elio
description_html: Elio came in after living with some cat friends near an auto body shop. They kept getting stuck inside the vehicles so that lifestyle became too dangerous for them! Elio is done living life on the edge. He's a soft boy with a shy personality and he'd rather lounge on your sofa than work on your car. This boy is unique because he's polydactyl. That means he has thumbs! Elio has joined our Cactus Cats program so he can enjoy the companionship of other shy felines and get extra attention from volunteers. He may prefer a home with cat friends and a patient, savvy adopter to guide him on his journey towards being a more confident and brave boy!

name: George
description_html:
George is an easy dog to fall for. Even when he was staying in the crate room, he kept his space neat and tidy, often relaxing with his paws crossed like a perfect gentleman. He was great about letting volunteers know when he needed to go outside, which suggests he may be housetrained.


On walks, George is a loose leash walker with only mild pulling when something catches his attention. He enjoys sniffing and exploring, checks in often with his handler, and is curious but friendly around both people and other dogs. He's playful, happy, and always seems ready to have fun.


George has quickly become a volunteer favorite thanks to his sweet personality, easy leash manners, and joyful spirit. If you're looking for a playful companion who's just as happy exploring the world as he is spending time with his people, George is ready to meet you.

name: Maiev
description_html:
After six years in a home, Maiev was sadly left behind. Thankfully, caring neighbors stepped in—one made sure she was fed, and another reached out for help.


Despite everything, Maiev remains a sweet, affectionate cat with so much love left to give. She’s gentle, grateful, and ready for a quiet forever home where she can finally feel safe and cherished again.


Older cats like Maiev make deeply loyal companions, and she is hoping for someone to give her the second chance she truly deserves.

name: Velma
description_html:
Before long, Velma will have you wondering how you ever lived without her. This gentle, laid-back girl is the definition of an easy companion. She's a loose-leash walker who loves treats, checks in often with her person, and happily soaks up all the pets and affection you have to give.

Velma seems housetrained, ignores both people and other dogs on walks, and has a calm, sweet nature that makes spending time with her a joy. Though she can be a little shy at first, she warms up quickly with a gentle approach and is an easy "clip and go" pup once she's ready. If you're looking for a loyal best friend who will happily stroll by your side and then relax with you at home, Velma is ready to fill that role.

name: Luna
description_html:
Luna lived for the last several months with adults and teens, in an apartment setting, getting walks daily. She was quiet there, except during meal times, her favorite times of the day!

Luna knows some things like sit, shake and paw and she stayed home alone well when the family was gone for 1-3 hrs at a time. She likes having her own dog bed.

Outside Luna passes other large dogs easily. At the shelter Luna has been play group tested and shares her kennel with a dog friend her size.

Luna is ready to exchange her kennel to become a new family member.

Ask to meet her.

name: Senora
description_html:
Meet Senora, a cat with a big personality and an even bigger voice!


She came to the shelter when her owner no longer had time to care for her, but they described her as sweet, playful, cuddly, and very talkative.


Senora’s raspy meow is unforgettable—she’s basically a little rock star (we’ve joked she could be Stevie Nicks!).🎤🎶


Beyond her voice, she’s a loving companion who enjoys attention, playtime, and being close to her people. If you’re looking for a fun, affectionate cat with lots of charm, Senora is ready to meet you.

name: Julius
description_html:
Julius is handsome and very sweet! When he arrived at AAS, he had a right femoral fracture, which was repaired with a pin, plate and screws. He then moved into a foster home for supportive care. He has made a complete recovery and has resumed normal activity without any issues.

Julius is playful, and gets along wonderfully with other cats. He may be a little shy at first, but he warms up quickly. He will do best in a quiet home, with or without a cat buddy. He loves being petted, and is a huge purr machine.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Julius and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Monte
description_html:
The shelter is no place for a 13-year old cat. 💔🐾

Meet Monte, a sweet senior boy who arrived as a stray. He’s clearly been someone’s beloved companion. But instead of a cozy home, Monte is spending his days in a kennel—and he deserves so much more.

Senior cats like Monte have endless love to give. He just needs a soft place to land, a warm bed, and a family to spend his golden years with. Please don’t let Monte wait any longer. He is available for foster or adoption. Come meet him today! ❤️🏡

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Monte and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Beaux
description_html:
Beaux is a high-energy cuddlebug with an impressive brain and an enormous capacity for affection. His former owner says he loves curling up right beside his person and will lie there contentedly for as long as the pets continue. When it is time to get moving, Beaux is ready for running, fetch, tug-of-war, walks, squeaky toys, stuffed toys, or a good chew bone.


Beaux has already learned 'sit', 'down', 'come', 'look at me', and can even bark on cue! Recent shelter outings have shown that he can be an excellent loose-leash walker. He has also participated successfully in shelter playgroup, where he ran into the yard, enjoyed push-pull play, and was paired with a doggy roommate. Beaux has potential to live with a well-matched canine companion, so ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!


Beaux recently met a family with four children ages nine through seventeen and appeared to be living his best life—allowing everyone to pet him and leaning against them to request even more affection.


His former owner reported that Beaux could be wary of unfamiliar people, particularly when someone entered his home or approached too quickly. He does best with calm, gradual introductions, preferably outside the home, and may need a little time to decide that a new person is a friend. Once that happens, his former owner said he becomes thrilled to see them.


An active family that can provide structure, daily exercise and enrichment, and positive training will help this affectionate, clever dog thrive. Think that could be you? Come meet this sweet boy!

name: Alexandria
description_html:
💖 Meet Alexandria! 💖


Alexandria is a friendly, affectionate girl who has charmed everyone she meets since arrival.


Volunteers describe her play style as exuberant—she loves toys, playtime, and a good scratching post!

When she’s done playing, she’s all about love and leans in for pets and attention.


She is spayed and ready to go home today. If you’re looking for a playful, loving companion, Alexandria is waiting to meet you! 🏡🐾

name: Buck
description_html:
Buck’s former family summed up his best quality in three words: “Good dog, period.” This friendly, energetic boy is house-trained and reportedly did well when left alone for short periods, whether he was loose in the home or chilling in a crate.


Buck loves practically every dog activity he has encountered: fetch, tug-of-war, chase, walks, squeaky toys, and chew bones. He already knows 'sit', 'stay', and 'come' and will be happiest with a family ready to provide regular exercise, playtime, and opportunities to keep learning.


Buck also has excellent dog experience. He previously lived with another large dog successfully and during his shelter playgroup evaluation, he offered polite greetings and quickly settled into soft play with the other dogs. Buck could be a wonderful addition to a multi-dog home—ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!


His former owner also described him as playful with cats. Slow introductions and thoughtful supervision would still be important in a new home. As a young dog, Buck can be exuberant. His enthusiasm should be a great match for an active adopter looking for a cheerful playmate and adventure partner. Looking to add a new adventure buddy to your family? Come meet this sweet pup!

name: Snow
description_html:
Snow is a quiet, friendly girl with an impressive amount of home experience. In a home setting, she is housetrained and can remain loose in the house alone for several hours and remain on her best behavior! She routinely slept in a crate overnight and already knows 'sit', 'stay', and 'come'.


Snow has also lived with another dog and is playful with dogs both big and small. She has also participated in shelter playgroup and been paired with a doggy roommate. Snow was initially timid when entering the play yard for her first play group, but she tolerated enthusiastic greetings from other dogs and began exploring once she felt more comfortable. She may be a lovely match for a canine companion given a little time to settle in!


Her former owner also described Snow as playful around cats. As always, slow introductions and supervision will help everyone adjust successfully in a new home.


Snow enjoys chase, wrestling, squeaky toys, and chew bones. She even reportedly enjoys baths, being picked up, and having her nails trimmed! Snow may start out a little shy, but her quiet nature, excellent home skills, and friendly personality give her all the ingredients of a wonderful companion.

name: Galette
description_html:
🩷 Meet Gallette 🩷


Gallette was a little unsure when she first arrived, but with gentle handling this beautiful girl quickly showed her sweet, soft side. She’s a loving cat with a very loud, amazing purr and enjoys attention—though she can get a bit overstimulated and will let you know when she needs a break.


Gallette is looking for a calm, patient home where she can feel safe, enjoy a warm lap, and build trust at her own pace. Could you be her fresh start? 🏡🐾

name: Carmela
description_html:
From the moment she arrived, Carmela showed just how friendly she is—calm, gentle, and rubbing against her kennel for pets instead of hiding. It’s hard to believe a cat this loving was once fending for herself outside.


Carmela deserves a safe, cozy home and a family to love her forever. If you’re looking for a gentle, affectionate companion, Carmela is ready to meet you. ❤️ Can’t adopt? Please share her story—her perfect home may be just one post away. 🏡

name: Horacio
description_html:
Horacio may be feeling shy in the shelter, but give him the chance to settle in and another side of him begins to appear. This handsome shepherd has shown that beneath his initial uncertainty is a dog who can relax, socialize, and enjoy himself.


One place Horacio has really started to shine is around other dogs. During a recent shelter playgroup, he showed quiet interest from the catch pen, chose to enter the yard on his own, offered nice greetings, and went on to play with other AAC dogs Missy and Boss. He was comfortable enough afterward to be paired with a doggy roommate, too. Horacio may be a wonderful candidate for a home with a well-matched canine companion—ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs.


Horacio can be fearful when first entering an unfamiliar environment, so he will appreciate adopters who understand that first impressions aren’t always the whole dog. Calm handling, patience, and the freedom to approach new experiences at his own pace should help him build confidence.


For someone willing to give a shy dog a little time to unfold, Horacio could be an especially rewarding friend—and his growing comfort with other dogs may help him feel at home even faster. Come meet this shy sweetie today!

name: Tomas
description_html: Meet Tomas, an easygoing, handsome boy with a big heart and an even bigger smile! Despite his impressive size, Tomas is a dream to walk on a leash. He loves engaging in playful fun, whether that means fetching toys or happily bouncing around the yard, but he’s just as quick to settle down when it’s time to relax. Above all, Tomas is a world-class snuggler who lives for cozy lap time and warm cuddles. If you're looking for a gentle, affectionate giant who brings the perfect mix of play and chill, Tomas is ready to steal your heart!

name: Ivy
description_html:
Meet Ivy: Your Loyal, Pocket-Sized Partner in Crime!

Age: 2 years old

Breed: German Shepherd mix (behaves like a Golden Retriever)

Size: Medium (about 45lbs)

Behavior: Submissive, affectionate toward all people

Looking for a devoted shadow who will make you feel like the center of the universe? Meet Ivy! She may be a GSD, but she comes in a wonderfully petite, medium-sized package.

Ivy is the ultimate "velcro" dog. Whether you’re working from home, making coffee, or moving room to room, Ivy will be right there beside you, watching with intense curiosity and the most adorable head tilts. She loves to explore and sniff out everything in her environment, but what she craves most is a sense of safety, security, and gentle validation from her human. Give her a few pets or a neck scratch, and you’ll have a friend for life! (And if you stop petting her, don't be surprised if she gives you a soft nudge or a lick to remind you that her affection meter needs topping off.)

What Makes Ivy Special:

  • Gentle House Manners: Indoors, Ivy is an absolute angel. She is polite, quiet, extremely gentle, and has no interest in getting into any mischief.
  • House trained and crate trained: She has had zero accidents in the foster home and runs into the crate when she's asked to.
  • Fetch Enthusiast: Ivy loves a good game of fetch! She’s a polite player who happily returns the ball right to you, asking nicely for the next throw.
  • Dog Friendly & Playful: Ivy gets along great with other dogs and loves to play. She’d make a fantastic addition to an existing pack, but she’s also more than happy to soak up all the love as an only dog.
  • Leash Savvy: She already knows "sit" and has lovely leash manners, staying right by your side during walks.

Ivy can be a little tender-hearted and shy in brand-new, loud, or uncertain situations (including thunderstorms, where she prefers a cozy indoor spot to retreat to). But with a patient, loving owner using gentle encouragement, her confidence truly shines.

If you want a smart, affectionate, and fiercely loyal companion, you will never feel lonely again with Ivy by your side.

name: Dobby
description_html:
Dobby is a big, affectionate young dog with big puppy enthusiasm and an equally big heart. His human friends describe him as sweet and extremely affectionate. He loves fetch, tug-of-war, chase, and being involved in whatever his people are doing.


Dobby already knows 'sit', 'stay', and 'down'. In a home setting, he has done well with house-training and being crated when home alone. He previously lived with a three-year-old child and cats, and his family said he got along with them.


Dobby also has promising dog skills. During his first shelter playgroup, he was nervous about the initial greetings and asked the other dogs for some space. Once he realized he was safe, he relaxed and spent the rest of the session enjoying soft play. He has potential to live with a well-matched dog, so ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!


At ten months old, Dobby is still very much a teenager. An active family prepared to provide exercise, training, appropriate chew toys, and gradual alone-time practice will be rewarded with an outgoing, playful, and deeply affectionate companion.

name: Rocky
description_html: Rocky is the sweetest nugget. He is a great smaller size and quite laid back for a puppy. He is smart and snuggly. Come scoop him up!

name: Bond
description_html:
💙 Meet Bond 💙


Bond arrived at the shelter very scared, often hiding in the back of his kennel. We knew there was a sweet kitten underneath—and we were right. With time and patience, Bond has started to come out of his shell. He now accepts gentle pets and is growing braver every day, though he’s still a bit shy.


He needs a patient, loving home where he can settle in at his own pace. Once he feels safe, we know he’ll blossom into a loving, affectionate companion. Could you be the one to give Bond his forever home? 🏡🐾

name: Shiloh
description_html:
Meet Shiloh! 🐾


Shiloh is a playful, happy kitten ready for his forever home. He arrived with his seven siblings and has fully recovered from an upper respiratory infection.


Now he’s back to doing what he loves—playing, wrestling, and exploring with endless kitten energy, then curling up for cozy naps.


Shiloh enjoys other cats and would love a home with a feline friend, especially one of his siblings. He is neutered and ready to go home today. If you’re looking for a fun, affectionate kitten, Shiloh is ready to meet you!

name: Schotzie
description_html:
Meet Schotzie! 🩷🐾


Schotzie is a playful, mischievous kitten who turns everything into an adventure! She arrived with her seven siblings and has fully recovered from an upper respiratory infection.


Her favorite “job” is helping staff with kennel cleaning—she thinks every broom and hand is a toy! When she’s not causing adorable chaos, she’s wrestling with her siblings or snuggling in for a nap.


Schotzie would love a home with another playful cat or to be adopted with one of her siblings. She is spayed and ready to go home today!

name: Zoey
description_html:
Zoey is not at her best right now. She may not like other cats, and she is stressed. She needs out of her kennel, either through adoption or foster.

Zoey lived in a home her entire life, and her owner described her as playful and friendly. She sometimes likes to be by herself, but otherwise she’s a lap cat. She is shy with new people, and is especially afraid of men (although she will eventually warm to them).

Zoey needs a quiet environment as the only pet with someone who will give her plenty of time to relax. Once she decompresses, she will be a wonderful companion.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Zoey and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Jefferson
description_html:
Jefferson is a laid-back, silly guy who enjoys taking life at a leisurely pace. He’s a fantastic walking companion if you prefer a slow stroll over a cardio workout! Jefferson is an excellent loose-leash walker and happily clips in and goes, with no pulling or reactivity toward people or other dogs.


He loves taking his time to sniff and explore, and he seems perfectly content entertaining himself in the yard. At the same time, he’s interested in interacting with his people and has a playful, comedic personality that is sure to make you smile. He’s calm and relaxed in his kennel and appears to be housetrained, too.


Jefferson could be a great fit for a variety of homes, including an apartment or condo, as long as he gets regular leisurely strolls and opportunities to explore. If you’re looking for an independent, easygoing companion with a goofy side, Jefferson might be your guy!

name: Mew
description_html: Very very sweet - interacts well with other dogs. Positive, easy going demeanor. Came into shelter with sister (sesame named Sable. See profile for 30185) if open to adopting both. However, don’t think mandatory

name: Sable
description_html: Very sweet but shy- more cautious of other dogs but seems to interact well. She has a brother (cream Shiba. see profile for Mew-30183) that was brought into shelter with her if open to adopting both (however, don’t think needs to be mandatory)

name: Twinkle Toes
description_html:
An absolute angel, Twinkle Toes will steal your heart!!

She’s very calm, cuddly and sweet. She would love to curl up in a lap.


She's leash trained, house trained and crate trained. She gets along well with everyone.

She's living alongside two big dogs, two little dogs, and a cat that loves her in a foster home.


Twinkle Toes has one eye that is cloudy. She seems to hear and get around quite well. She's in a foster home getting in her best shape ever by gaining a little weight and getting her fur back to full luster. She's ready to meet you now! Inquire on her link.

name: Johnny
description_html:
💗 Johnny is looking for her second chance at a home. 


When Johnny arrived, she was very scared—but never aggressive, just overwhelmed. She later recovered from an upper respiratory infection and is now feeling much better. 


During her spay surgery prep, we discovered something surprising: Johnny was already spayed. That means she was once someone’s pet. We don’t know what happened, but we do know this: she deserves to be loved again.

﻿

Johnny is still a little shy, but we believe there’s a sweet, affectionate cat waiting to shine with time, patience, and a safe home.

name: Tintin
description_html: Tintin, with his handsome dark brindle coat, is a pup with a smile that lights up every room! With his perfectly balanced medium energy, Tintin is always up for a fun game of happily chasing down his favorite toys with classic, tail-wagging enthusiasm. Once playtime wraps up, this sweet boy instantly transitions into world-class cuddle mode, eager to lean right in and soak up all the affection you have to offer. Whether you’re heading out for a stroll or cozying up on the couch, Tintin is ready to be your ultimate best friend!

name: Champion
description_html:
Champion is a sweet boy who loves snuggles and belly rubs. Throughout his foster stay he’s developed a fondness for blankets and pillows and curling up beside our dog so as not to miss out on any pets.


He sits patiently, channeling his excitement in sweeping tail wags, when you reach for the harness by the door or scoop food into his bowl. Gentle head nudges and low sighs let you know when he’s ready for cuddles, or a paw on your knee will tell you he’s ready for a walk.


He is house trained and knows basic commands - he and can even shake your hand and roll over! He would be great in a home with other dogs, or as a solo-doggo.

name: Mark
description_html:
Do you want your very own Jiji from Kiki’s Delivery Service? This little panther may be the guy for you!


Mark lived in his foster mom’s yard for a little while before she lured him inside with some food. He’s still pretty new at being an indoor cat but he’s picking things up very quickly. He’s a little shy to start but within two days we accomplished important milestones like “getting picked up is kinda fun” and “I actually love the wand toy and it is not scary at all!” Currently we’re slowly working on “nail clippers=churus??” and it is going very well!


Mark loves wet food with a passion and you’ll never have to worry about giving him pills because if they’re in a pile of pate he won’t even notice. The only thing he loves more is his foster sister, who is really more of an independent lady, but that’s ok because Mark has the best cat to cat manners his foster mom has ever seen. A true gentleman who respects all cat signals! He would do great in a multi cat household if you’ve got another cat looking for a friend. He’s also fine with dogs (aka not interested).

name: Gecko
description_html:
💔 Gecko is still waiting—and now he's waiting alone.


Gecko is a very shy kitty who has shown patience with volunteers, but still needs time to feel fully comfortable with people. He doesn’t seek out pets yet, but will allow gentle affection if you go slow—small steps that show trust is starting to grow. ❤️


Gecko used to find comfort in his sibling, Iggy, but Iggy has since been adopted, leaving Gecko without their familiar companion. This is a cat who may take time. He may not rush into your arms—but they still deserve a home. Gecko needs an experienced, patient adopter who understands shy cats and is willing to let trust build at Gecko’s pace.

name: Brooks
description_html:
Meet Brooks! 🎸🐾


Brooks arrived at the shelter with his brother, Dunn—who has already been adopted. Yes, someone broke up the band!


Now it’s Brooks’ turn to shine. This handsome boy is very affectionate and loves attention from people. Even while being treated for an upper respiratory infection, he continues to show his sweet, loving personality.


URI is common in shelter kittens, and Brooks is receiving the care he needs. What he really needs now is a family to help him finish healing and start his new life in a home. If you’re looking for a loving, people-oriented kitten, Brooks is ready to meet you!

name: Eduardo
description_html:
Eduardo is a new member of our Cactus Cat family! He's not spicy, he's just a scaredy cat in new situations. But, all you have to do is offer a hand and he will gladly accept pets and relax. He loves his cat friends so he may do best with a cat companion in his new home.

Eduardo is a former community cat who was not thriving and may have actually been abandoned previously. His left eye is small or missing due to a chronic issue. It's not giving him trouble now but his vision is likely limited to the right eye.

Eduardo needs a calm place to relax and come out of his shell at his own pace. He's a loving and affectionate boy with people he knows, and having a cat friend will likely speed up his acclimation.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Eduardo and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Bea
description_html:
Meet Bea – A Gentle Girl Waiting for Her Chance


Bea was brought to the shelter by a kind person who described her as very friendly. She was the perfect lady for our veterinary team during intake.


The shelter can be overwhelming, so Bea is a little shy here. But give this sweet girl a chance, and you'll see her gentle, loving personality shine through.


Bea just needs a quiet, caring home where she can feel safe and be herself. In return, she'll be a wonderful companion with a kind heart. Come meet Bea and see how special she is!

name: Bamboo
description_html:
Meet Bamboo, the incredible younger half of the pair Bamboo and Panda, his BFF. They've been having loads of fun in their foster home, after losing their lifelong home due to a crisis. They are all about L.O.V.E and soft affections. They are seeking of sweet people, one for her? one for him? or an entire family! They also enjoy other friendly dogs. They like to play softly with toys, lay between human feet, find comfort spots to rest and recharge, and then get up and do it all over again. They are house trained. Each has had some basic obedience training and know cues. Panda has some cat skills too, Bamboo hasn't yet met cats. Bamboo loves walks and wants to meet everyone because he's so very social.


Bamboo and Panda are marked as bonded yet function pretty independently once they are established in a home. They are finishing up their basic veterinary care needs and will be available for adoption soon. If you have been ready for a sweet pair of dogs for your home, please do reach out on the link of Bamboo and Panda (30143) to make a connection to their foster.

name: Panda
description_html:
Meet Panda, the incredible older sister of the pair Bamboo and Panda. They've been having loads of fun in their foster home, after losing their lifelong home due to a crisis. They are all about L.O.V.E and soft affections. They are seeking of sweet people, one for her? one for him? or an entire family! They also enjoy other friendly dogs. They like to play softly with toys, lay between human feet, find comfort spots to rest and recharge, and then get up and do it all over again. They are house trained. Each has had some basic obedience training and know cues. Panda has some cat skills too, Bamboo hasn't yet met cats. Both dogs are incredibly social.


Panda and Bamboo (30142) are marked as bonded yet function pretty independently once they are established in a home. They are finishing up their basic veterinary care needs and will be available for adoption soon. If you have been ready for a sweet pair of dogs for your home, please do reach out on the link of Panda and Bamboo (30142) to make a connection to their foster.

name: Baby
description_html:
💔 Baby needs a second chance.


Meet Gorgeous Baby—and she really lives up to her name. 


She arrived at the shelter very scared and overwhelmed, but we quickly learned there’s a sweet girl underneath. With Churu, Baby comes right out—and even enjoys gentle pets while she eats. 


She was adopted… but sadly returned the very next day through no fault of her own. Now she’s back, confused and waiting again. Baby just needs a patient home where she can take her time to feel safe and decompress. Once she does, her sweet personality will start to shine through. 😻

name: Zara
description_html:
Meet Zara, a beautiful, affectionate girl with a soft voice and an even softer heart!


She’ll chirp sweetly when it’s mealtime, but she’s just as happy to climb into your lap, rub all over you, and soak up every bit of attention you’ll give her.


Zara arrived as a stray, but she clearly loves people. She’s gentle, cuddly, and ready to be your constant companion.

name: Haven
description_html:
Haven is a friendly young dog who is learning that the world can be a pretty fun place. She started out shy in shelter playgroup, but with a little time she blossomed into soft play with the other dogs and even began seeking affection from her handlers.


Haven may be a lovely match for a patient family—and potentially a well-matched canine friend—who can help her continue building confidence. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!

name: Wyatt
description_html:
Wyatt LOVES other cats, and will be happiest with a cat buddy! He also likes people, but he’s a little shy at first. He is a former community cat, and when he was brought to AAS, x-rays revealed a fracture to his left front leg. Because the injury was older, surgical correction was not an option.

Wyatt moved into a foster home for medical management (including weeks of crate rest). Follow up x-rays confirmed that the fracture has formed a good bony callous, and we don’t anticipate any issues in the future (he must live indoors). 

Wyatt needs a quiet environment, and some time to warm up. He likes being petted, but if you pet him too long, he’ll give a little nip or simply walk away.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Wyatt and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Sofie
description_html:
This playful little girl has grown up at the shelter, and now she's ready for her big break! 💕 She's still learning about all the fun and exciting things life has to offer, but she's a quick learner and eager to discover it all with her person by her side.

She's an active girl who loves playtime, but more than anything, she just wants to be near you. As a puppy, she's still learning her manners and figuring out this whole big world, but with a little patience, guidance, and lots of love, we know she'll continue to be an amazing companion.

She's been waiting for her chance to experience life outside the shelter. Could you be the one to show her just how wonderful it can be? 🐾❤️

name: Pepper
description_html:
Pepper is the sweetest 5 year old golden retriever mix. He's crate trained, potty trained, good on a leash, and knows several commands such as sit, "in" (for his crate), stay, down, roll over, and speak!


He loves being around his humans and likes going on walks but is also content just sitting by your feet while you're on the couch. He also likes to be brushed. He is very loyal and protective so it's best to meet new people outside before bringing guests inside.

name: Oreo
description_html:
Double stuffed with affection and charm! Oreo’s perfect day includes window watching, chasing his fishing wand, enjoying treats, and lounging near his favorite people. This curious gentleman loves to know what’s happening around him and even though he may be a little shy initially, he is always ready to investigate something or someone new.

When he’s not exploring, Oreo is happily soaking up pets, and he’s just as eager to give affection right back.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Oreo and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Banana Cream
description_html:
Banana Cream is a shy-at-first sweetheart with a playful puppy hiding just beneath the surface. New situations can make her uncertain, but once she has a little time to settle in, she begins to show a much sillier side—play bows, soft puppy mouthing, and all.


Her first shelter playgroup followed that same pattern. Banana Cream initially sat quietly with her tail tucked and was uncomfortable when dogs approached too quickly. As the session went on, she relaxed, began throwing play bows, and eventually joined fellow shelter pups Polly Pocket and Dakota for chase play. She was comfortable enough afterward to be paired with a doggy roommate.


Banana Cream is looking for people who understand that confidence doesn’t always appear instantly. She does best when she isn’t rushed and is allowed to investigate at her own pace. Once she decides she feels safe, she can be playful, engaging, and downright goofy.


She has potential to live with a well-matched dog, particularly one who won’t overwhelm her with an intense greeting. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs.


For an adopter who enjoys watching a shy dog blossom into herself, Banana Cream could be an incredibly rewarding companion. Come meet her today!

name: Sabo
description_html:
With a large grin to match his large frame Sabo is ready to welcome everyone into his space. He adores people, adores friendly dogs, and adores children he has met along the path of life.

Sabo appreciates being part of the indoors family which is why shelter living is a shocker for this sweet guy. He's very house trained. He's stayed home alone for 4-8 hour stretches at a time, on his own with no troubles. He becomes his younger self when squishy toys are near, they're his favorite.

He is RTG - Ready to Go - meaning he's neutered, vaccinated and meets all the qualifications to leave right away in adoption/foster/rescue opportunities. He's also heart worm negative.

Please reach out without further delay by visiting onsite or writing his advocates at caring@classiccanines.org

Don't delay when a shelter dog is waiting for a helping hand out.

name: Pepita
description_html:
Pepita is a sweet, independent girl who likes to take a little time to get comfortable. Once she settles in, she enjoys exploring, accepts affection, and has even opened up into play with other dogs during shelter playgroup.


Pepita walks nicely on leash and may be a great candidate for a well-matched canine companion. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!

name: Marty
description_html:
Meet Marty, a gentle, resilient soul. His people lost their housing and life was tough. They surrendered Marty so he could fine a happier, healthier life ahead. He's catching up on his weight and polishing his skin. He'll be as good as new to match the trusting, affectionate, kind soul he's always been with years of wisdom behind him.

Marty is housetrained, walks well on loose leash and loves to sniff and explore. He's a gentle friend who stays by your side for walks and doesn't mind stopping and talking to friends and passing other dogs. He also knows some basic cues. At home he's house trained and crate trained.

Time is precious for a dog waiting to recapture his life outside of the shelter walls. Don't delay when a shelter dog like Marty is spending another night sleeping in the shelter.

name: Dodge
description_html:
Dodge may be a big boy, but he’s the definition of a gentle giant. He is incredibly sweet, affectionate, and loves with his whole heart. His favorite place to be is wherever his people are, whether that’s lounging nearby, cuddling on the couch, or resting his head in your lap for pets.

He’s great with most people, gets along well with other dogs, and has been nothing but kind and gentle while in our home. He’s a laid-back boy who enjoys playing, but he’s just as happy spending most of the day relaxing by your side.

Dodge rarely barks. If he’s left alone, he may whine for a little while, but he settles himself down and relaxes. He can be a bit stubborn when it’s time to get off the bed, but it’s hard not to smile because he’s always so loving and gentle. He’s also an excellent car companion and rides like a pro and is potty trained!

If you’re looking for a loyal, affectionate dog with a calm, loving personality, Dodge is your guy.

name: Alfonso
description_html: Alfonso is such a cute Chow Chow! He loves zoomies and is a gentle teddy bear. He is a quiet guy, mostly independent, but likes affection too! Meet this floofball and see if he is the perfect fit for you.

name: Nilla
description_html: Nilla is what we lovingly call a "boss lady". She was found outside a restaurant, but there's no way this soft, round girl was trying to survive outdoors, so her history is a bit of a mystery! She enjoys pets in moderation and will let you know when she's had enough. Nilla is an independent girl with dreams and ambitions of her own, such as having a home to manage, windows to watch the neighbors, and a friend to share gossip. This boss is ready for her new job, so apply today to adopt this beauty!

name: Jimmy
description_html: Jimmy is a friendly little guy who warms up to people quickly! He loves nose rubs and lap sitting with some fresh veggies (cilantro and parsley are his favorites). He doesn’t mind carefully supervised interaction with other pets and has done well around cats and dogs. He will make an easygoing companion for his forever home. Plus, he has the cutest white wig and big googly baby eyes!

name: Lasso
description_html:
Lasso came to the shelter very scared and unsure of people, but he’s already making steady progress.


He’s a quiet kitten who likes to take things at his own pace. He may hiss when his kennel door is opened, but it’s just fear—not aggression. With a Churu treat and a gentle approach, he quickly warms up and will accept soft pets.


Lasso is still building confidence, but he’s improving every day. In a calm, patient home, we know he will continue to blossom and learn that people can be kind and safe. He keeps getting overlooked, but he just needs someone willing to go slow and let trust grow one step at a time.

name: Tomas
description_html:
Tomas came to us from a home with far too many cats—we’ve taken in over 50 from that location alone. He’s one of the lucky ones getting a fresh start.


From day one, it was clear Tomas loves other cats… maybe a little too much! 😘This affectionate boy recently had his neuter surgery, and now that his hormones are settling, his sweet personality is starting to shine through.


Tomas is friendly, social, and ready to leave the past behind. Can you be the home to give him a second chance? Meet Tomas today!

name: Prissy
description_html:
A lovely & loving lady, so easy & gentle to be with. She adores people-they make her heart sing!


Prissy is RTG - READY TO GO -she's spayed, vaccinated, heart worm negative and knows a whole lot about good home living. She lived with a family for the last 4 years practicing all her good girl skills, staying home alone, house and crate trained, for 4-8 hrs. She's lived with a male dog friend. And she lived with a child. She's not as sure about cats but reserves the right to change her mind after studying them from a safe distance for awhile.


Her owner said: she loves soft beds and loves to relax. She loves watching squirrels and loves kids.

Prissy has the advocacy of her friends at Classic Canines who give extra support for the mature dogs. This lady is ready to slide into a loving stable home that will suit her for years to come. Inquire on her link to connect with her foster.

name: Viola
description_html:
💜 Meet Viola — gorgeous, playful, and full of personality! 💜


Viola is a friendly, talkative, high-energy girl who loves toys and playtime!


She needs a cat-savvy adopter, as she can get overstimulated and sometimes plays a bit too rough. She’ll thrive with someone who can read her signals and guide her play in a positive way. Viola is also an escape artist, so she needs a safe, indoor-only home with someone ready for her adventurous spirit. 


She’s not just any cat — she’s a special girl looking for the right match. Could that be you? 💜🐱

name: Misty
description_html:
Misty may have a soft name, but she’s a true little fighter. 💪


She was very sick with a severe upper respiratory infection that caused dehydration, weight loss, and an eye infection. She required intensive care, including medication, nebulizer treatments, and twice-daily fluids from our veterinary team.


But Misty never gave up—and neither did we. Day by day, she grew stronger, and her playful, loving personality returned. Today, she’s healthy, happy, and ready for a forever home. Misty has overcome so much in her short life. Now she just needs someone to give this brave little survivor the loving home she deserves.

name: Darcy
description_html:
Darcy arrived as a stray, but it was clear right away she’s a friendly, affectionate girl who likely once had a family. While at the shelter, she developed an upper respiratory infection and handled treatment like a champ. She’s now fully recovered and ready for a fresh start.


Darcy is incredibly affectionate and absolutely loves being around people. She’s playful, energetic, and full of personality, always ready for fun or a cuddle. She’s also very food-motivated—canned food is the way to her heart! 🍽️


Darcy would thrive in a home where she’ll get plenty of love, attention, and interaction. She has so much affection to give and would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a sweet, adorable cat to share life with.


Darcy deserves a soft bed, a full bowl, and a loving home where she’ll never have to fend for herself again. Could Darcy be your new best friend? ❤️🐾

name: Junie
description_html:
Junie is an absolute sweetheart who makes every outing easy and enjoyable! She’s a calm, loose-leash walker who loves taking her time to sniff and explore, especially when she can stroll on the grass rather than concrete. Junie is also very treat motivated and absolutely loves her snacks!

After spending more than two weeks in a crate at the shelter, Junie has done well with her kennel routine and seems comfortable with crate time. She also enjoys relaxing on the couch with her volunteer friends and soaking up some companionship. She’s interested in being around other dogs and has a playful side, too.

Junie is a laid-back, affectionate girl who would be happy with someone looking for a sweet, easygoing companion. She’s housetrained, leash trained, cuddly, and ready to find a comfortable couch—and a person to share it with!

name: Bandido
description_html:
Bandido is a fun-loving, affectionate guy with plenty of personality! He’s got lots of energy when he first gets out of his kennel and may be jumpy or a little mouthy, but he gets his “ya-yas” out quickly and settles down beautifully. Once he’s had some exercise and playtime, Bandido is happy to slow down and ask for kisses and belly rubs.


Bandido is playful, curious, and very interested in people. He enjoys sniffing and exploring and gives his handler lots of check-ins. He can be easily distracted and is reactive to other dogs, with some barking and lunging, but he’s been easy to redirect. He’s also a strong leash puller and would do best with a harness rather than a slip leash or collar.


Although his previous family reported that he wasn’t housetrained, Bandido has consistently kept his kennel dry and urgently goes potty outdoors as soon as he gets outside, suggesting he may have good outdoor potty habits. He’s an active, playful companion who will thrive with regular exercise, enrichment, and someone who appreciates a silly, affectionate dog with a big personality.

name: Mercy
description_html:
Longer, more detailed bio to replace the one-liner she has now :

Mercy is a sweet, affectionate young dog with a huge zest for life. She loves people, loves being petted, and has been described by shelter staff as friendly with everyone she meets. She also walks beautifully on leash, making her a great candidate for an active family who wants a companion for daily adventures. 

Mercy is also very social with other dogs. When she first entered shelter playgroup, she greeted with happy tail wags and play bows and jumped right into fun, puppyish play. She’ll likely do great in a home with a well-matched canine companion—ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dog(s)!

At heart, Mercy is a friendly, playful, people-loving girl who is ready for a chance to decompress outside the shelter and show off her best self. If you’re looking for an affectionate, joyful companion with plenty of personality, come meet Mercy.

name: Eva
description_html:
Eva is a young dog that is understandably nervous of the loud shelter environment. Go slow and at her pace, and she will warm up with tail wags and playful zooms. She enjoys sniffing and exploring.


Eva is a sweet girl that is shy and she just crave chest scratches then it all changed. She'll happily seat there for hours when the scratches get going.

She is determined and gave me the smart girl vibes. She seems very interested in going to meet doggy friends.

name: Tia
description_html:
Tia is a truly special soul. Although she and her best friend, Tamara, had a heartbreaking start to life, Tia has chosen to meet the world with kindness, trust, and a gentle heart. She quickly warms up to people, loves treats, knows how to sit, and takes snacks with the softest touch.


This sweet girl is a dream to handle. She appears housetrained, walks beautifully on a loose leash, is calm in her kennel, and enjoys quietly exploring the play yard before checking back in with her person. Volunteers describe her as incredibly gentle and affectionate—a quiet companion who simply wants to be close to you and soak up all the love you have to give.

name: Tamara
description_html:
Tamara is proof that love can endure. Despite being treated with cruelty in the past, she still greets people with trust, kindness, and an endless supply of affection. She's an easygoing, medium-energy girl who walks beautifully on a loose leash, appears housetrained, and loves to check in with her person while exploring. Whether she's sniffing around the yard or simply following you from place to place, Tamara's happiest when she's by your side.


She is very gentle, treat-motivated, and absolutely adores attention. Volunteers describe her as a "100% darling dog"—the kind of companion who makes every outing easy and enjoyable.

name: Xiao Mao
description_html: Itty bitty tuxedo cat with moon shoes. She followed me home in the neighborhood and now I am trying to find her a home~

name: Simon
description_html:
Simon is a gentle, sweet soul who's ready to leave shelter life behind and find a loving home. While he may be a little shy at first, it doesn't take long for his affectionate side to shine through. He loves spending quiet time with his person and happily soaks up cuddles and attention.


Simon is easy to leash, walks beautifully on a loose leash, and enjoys peaceful strolls. He also likes relaxing in the play yard and has been friendly with dogs in neighboring yards. He appears to be housetrained and has a calm, laid-back personality that makes him a wonderful companion.


Right now, Simon is very underweight and would benefit from a home where he can enjoy good meals, plenty of love, and the chance to grow into his happiest, healthiest self. If you're looking for a kind, cuddly best friend with a gentle heart, Simon may be the perfect match.

name: Max
description_html:
Max is a sweet, energetic guy who loves to play and enjoys the company of other dogs. He has had great playgroup sessions full of tail wags and chase play and may be a wonderful match for a multi-dog household. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!


Max can be enthusiastic, but recent staff observations describe him as a loose-leash walker. If you’re looking for a playful adventure buddy who may also enjoy having a dog friend at home, come meet Max!

name: Pickle Juice
description_html: Pickle Juice (or PJ) is the little sister of the litter and loves to be cuddled by her siblings. She is a LOVER and wants to hold hands or at least be held in your hand. She’s playful and curious and such a lap cat!

name: Lemonade
description_html: Lemonade (known affectionately as “Lemmy Love” or “Lemontine”) is the itty bitty boy of the litter. He is small, but LOVES to eat his food first. He leads playtime with his siblings every morning and has engineered a slide out of a cardboard box.

name: Riley
description_html:
🐾 Riley is looking for someone who will believe in her. 💕


Riley is a very timid kitten who is still learning to trust people, so she’ll need an experienced adopter who can continue her socialization at her own pace.


Her biggest love? Churu! It’s the fastest way to her heart and a great way to help her learn that people can be kind. With patience and consistency, she may slowly begin to accept gentle affection—but she needs time and understanding.


Riley would also do best with a confident cat friend, like her more brave brother Rocko or another social kitty, to help show her the way. 🐱 She may not be an instant lap cat, but for the right person, helping her grow in confidence will be incredibly rewarding.

name: Rocko
description_html:
🐾 Meet Rocko — a very playful boy looking for the right person. ❤️


Rocko LOVES to play, but he’s still a bit unsure about humans, so he’ll need an experienced adopter who understands that trust takes time.


His heart is won with playtime and treats —and he’ll thrive with patience and a gentle approach. Rocko would also love a feline friend, especially his sister Riley or another playful cat to bond and cuddle with. 


He may not be an instant cuddler, but for the right person, earning his trust will be incredibly rewarding.

name: Oliver
description_html:
If you are looking for the ultimate mix of adventure buddy and couch potato, look no further than Oliver! This handsome German Shepherd has a heart of gold and a personality that instantly wins everyone over.


Why You'll Fall in Love


Leash Rockstar: Oliver does amazing on the leash, making walks and neighborhood strolls an absolute breeze.


Playful & Active: He is a champion at fetch and lives for splashing around in the pool on warm days.


Affectionate Snuggler: After he gets his energy out, Oliver’s favorite place in the world is right next to you, soaking up all the pets and cuddles.


Oliver is ready to bring so much joy, loyalty, and fun to his forever home. Come meet him today.

name: Daisy
description_html:
Meet Daisy 🌼


Daisy is ready for a fresh start after coming from a home with far too many cats—we’ve taken in over 50 from that location alone. Now she finally has the chance to relax and enjoy having her own space.


While she originally arrived with other cats she knew, Daisy has shown she prefers not to share her space with so many feline roommates. After a lifetime of competition, she’s ready to be the center of attention in a calmer home.


Since moving into her own kennel, Daisy has been settling in and enjoying the peace and quiet. She’s looking for a home where she can feel safe, loved, and appreciated...and be the only cat!!

name: Chadwick
description_html:
Chadwick came to the shelter with his brother, Lenny, after their owner could no longer care for them. Lenny quickly found a home, but Chadwick is still waiting. After spending all four years of his life in a loving home, shelter life has been a big adjustment. Chadwick can be a little overwhelmed here, but who could blame him? He’s still learning to feel comfortable in a busy shelter environment.


According to his previous owner, Chadwick is a wonderful companion: a sweet lap cat who loves people, gets along with cats and dogs, and even enjoys playing with water! He just needs someone to see the loving cat he is and give him the chance to be himself again. Could that family be yours?

name: Autumn
description_html:
Hi, I'm Autumn! I'm just three months old, but I'm already a very good girl! I'm house trained, crate trained, and I sit for pets and treats! I love playing with the dog in my foster home, but I'm also good at entertaining myself with a toy when he isn't in the room. My foster mom thinks I may have had a little bit of training because I walk up to her and sit when I want affection and I don't jump on her.


I LOVE going outside in my foster family's yard, where I do adorable army crawls through the grass, nap, and sunbathe when I'm not running around with their dog. At night, I am a very chill couch companion and enjoy watching television with the humans.


I also love receiving affection. I crave scratches on the chin and chest while I'm sitting, and I also roll onto my back for belly and chest scratches. I enjoy snuggles on the couch, too, but I'm not pushy about it.


Oh! I am also an excellent car rider! I sit or lay in one seat and stay calm the entire ride. Want to come pick me up and make me your forever pup?

name: Rumble
description_html:
Rumble is a sweet, playful guy with a serious love for fetch! He’s an energetic pup who gets very excited about playtime, but once he’s on leash or in the play yard, he settles in nicely and is fairly easy to handle. Rumble can be jumpy and mouthy when excited, especially during harnessing, but he was never aggressive or scary—just eager to get going!


He absolutely lights up when he sees a ball and will happily chase and retrieve it. He initially wanted to carry both the ball and thrower, but with a little redirection, he quickly figured out the game. Rumble is also housetrained, making him an even more appealing companion.


This lovable, high-energy boy would thrive with someone who enjoys an active, playful dog and can help him channel his excitement into fun activities. Rumble is ready to bring plenty of fetch, sweetness, and enthusiasm to his forever home!

name: ‘Bennett’ Buckingham Foster
description_html:
Bennett hasn’t had the easiest journey, but he’s ready to leave his outdoor days behind and find a loving home. He was brought to the shelter by an Animal Protection Officer after being found with his fur covered in stickers and some thinning hair, likely due to a flea allergy. Despite his rough start, Bennett was a perfect gentleman with our intake staff.


After treatment for an upper respiratory infection, Bennett is feeling much better and his sweet, laid-back personality is shining through. He loves the simple things in life—especially wet food! He’s calm, easygoing, and would make a wonderful quiet companion.


Bennett deserves a safe indoor home where he can relax, be loved, and never have to worry about the challenges of outdoor life again.

name: Harvey
description_html:
Meet Harvey! 🐾 All Harvey needs is 30 minutes… and he’ll steal your heart. ❤️


Harvey may be a little shy when he first meets new people, but give him about 30 minutes, and you’ll see his true personality shine. Once he feels safe, he transforms into a playful, affectionate little guy who loves being part of the action.

One of Harvey’s sweetest traits is that he starts purring the moment you pick him up. He enjoys cuddles, loves curling up next to his people for naps, and is happiest when he’s close to someone he trusts.

Harvey also gets along wonderfully with other cats, making him a great companion if you already have a feline friend at home. He’s already neutered and ready to settle into his forever family.

If you’re looking for a gentle cat who blossoms with a little patience and rewards you with endless purrs, cuddles, and companionship, Harvey is waiting to meet you. ❤️

name: Asher
description_html:
Asher is a smart, affectionate dog with an impressive trick repertoire and a wonderfully cuddly side. During a recent shelter outing, he spent ten minutes cuddling with his handler, gave kisses, accepted pets all over, and was easy to return to his kennel.


Asher knows 'sit', 'down', 'stay', 'come', 'spin', and 'drop it'. He responds beautifully when given a cue and rewarded for his good work, making training a fun way to build a relationship with him. His former family described him as athletic and playful but also content to relax for much of the day. His favorite activities include fetch, tug, chase, walks, squeaky toys, and chew bones.


Asher previously lived successfully with a female dog and has potential to live with another canine companion. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident pets!


Asher forms strong bonds with his people and prefers to choose when physical affection happens. His prior family reported that he could be uncomfortable with hugs, paw handling, or feeling cornered, so he needs patient adopters who will respect his signals and personal space. An adult, dog-savvy home would likely be his best match. He may also need continued help with house-training and feeling comfortable when left alone.

name: Gotham
description_html:
Gotham is a beautiful pup with his sleek dark coat, perky ears, and striking eyes—he’s guaranteed to turn heads everywhere he goes.

Despite his heroic name, Gotham isn't here to fight crime; he’s just here to steal your heart. He’s a friendly, energetic, and intelligent boy who loves playing with toys, learning new tricks, and going on adventures. After a fun session in the yard, he’s more than ready to shower you with happy smiles and affection.

Ready to meet your new superhero? Adopt or foster Gotham today!

name: Espionage
description_html:
Now through Saturday, August 15, 2026, we're waiving adoption fees for ALL pets adopted from foster care! 



Espionage and her sister Intrigue are looking for their forever home! Espionage is all black, but don't let her sneaky name and appearance fool you. She is very playful and good with other cats. (Not yet tested with dogs.) She loves to sleep on the cat tree, play with toys, and wrestle with her sister.

name: Daisy
description_html: Itty bitty baby Daisy, loves cuddles & kisses. Very calm nature, will follow you around & be your little shadow

name: Winslow
description_html: This is a great dog. He is potty trained and very sweet. He knows fetch and is a really good companion dog. He does have a bit of separation anxiety. He is also great with other dogs. Not sure about cats though. If you adopt him you will be a very lucky owner.

name: Intrigue
description_html:
Now through Saturday, August 15, 2026, we're waiving adoption fees for ALL pets adopted from foster care! 



Intrigue and her sister Espionage are looking for their forever home! True to her name, Intrigue finds everything intriguing and loves to explore. She is affectionate, playful, and has been good with the other cats in her foster home.

name: Diamond
description_html:
Diamond arrived at the shelter as a stray and immediately impressed everyone with her calm, gentle nature.


Not long after arriving, Diamond developed a severe upper respiratory infection. She needed extra TLC, including subcutaneous fluids to treat dehydration, nebulizer treatments, and antibiotics. Thanks to her resilient spirit and dedicated care, she has made a full recovery and is feeling like herself again.

Now, Diamond is ready for the next chapter of her life.


This sweet girl is affectionate, calm, and loves spending time with people. She's the kind of companion who will happily brighten your day with her gentle presence and loving personality. Come meet Diamond—you just might discover the missing gem in your family.

name: Boss
description_html:
Boss is an affectionate, outdoors-loving dog whose greatest talents are cuddling and making people feel loved. He is friendly with the people he meets and is ready to join his new family for both adventures and quality snuggle time.


Boss is house-trained and has experience with home life. He already knows 'sit' and 'stay' and has been left alone for several hours and done well. His favorite activities include fetch, tug-of-war, chase, wrestling, and spending time outside.


Boss also has excellent dog experience. He previously lived successfully with a 40-pound male dog, and he regularly participates in shelter playgroups. He began with soft, polite greetings and light play and has since become confident enough to enjoy a more physical, vocal play style with other dogs. He may be a wonderful match for another playful dog; ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs!


Boss is still polishing his leash manners and may jump when excited, but his enthusiasm is matched by his affectionate nature. He is frightened by thunderstorms and would appreciate a quiet, comfortable place to retreat when the weather gets loud.

name: Aramis
description_html:
Aramis, like his namesake, the lover of the Three Musketeers, is a lover, a sweet-natured playful boy. He's a purring machine when he's being held or pet, and is even chill with his foster's dog (see photo).


Aramis likes to play with his siblings, going around to each one and bugging them to play. He loves to wrestle with his brother, Porthos! And, like an overeager theater kid (but more endearing!), he'll butt in when one sibling is getting attention. See the series of photos with D'Artagnan--his little sister (adopted) was getting her photo taken, and he jumped onto the chair and laid on her. Aramis isn't vocal like Porthos, but the sweetest chirps will come out when it's time for food.


We’d love for Aramis to get adopted with his brother, Porthos. They love wrestling with each other, before they cuddle to rest. Two kittens are less work than one, as they are happier and get up to less trouble having each other to play with.


On how kittens are better in pairs, rather than solo:

http://www.kittenlady.org/twokittens

https://www.austinpetsalive.org/blog/two-kittens-are-better-than-one

name: Porthos
description_html:
Porthos is a beautiful medium-haired (potentially long-haired) boy with adorable ear tufts, wide eyes, and a Hello Kitty face. His wide face might be due to his love of eating--he's always the first one out to eat (see: the photo of him squishing his brother in the strawberry) and the last one to finish eating.


He's a keen explorer, yelling at his foster to let him out into the living room in the morning, and likes to romp with Aramis, his brother. He's also been fine with his foster's dog!


His foster likes having conversations with Porthos, when he lets his concerns known about not being let into the living room in the morning or if there's been a delay in feeding breakfast. Porthos is not constantly chatty, though. The conversations happen more so due to his foster's amusement over his initial complaints.


Porthos is also a total sweetie, and will rub against his foster's legs and give gentle pats with his paw if his foster is cuddling Aramis. Cuddling Porthos is a dream, with his long, soft fur.


We’d love for Porthos to get adopted with his brother, Aramis. They love wrestling with each other, before they cuddle to rest. Two kittens are less work than one, as they are happier and get up to less trouble having each other to play with.


On how kittens are better in pairs, rather than solo:

http://www.kittenlady.org/twokittens

https://www.austinpetsalive.org/blog/two-kittens-are-better-than-one

name: Java
description_html:
Java is a sweet, playful girl who may need just a moment to get comfortable before her personality comes shining through. Shelter staff describe her as shy at first, but quick to warm up, friendly, and very sweet.


Java has also shown lovely social skills with other dogs. During her shelter playgroup evaluation, she entered a little uncertain with her tail tucked, but quickly relaxed and began playing with another dog. When a more enthusiastic dog became too pushy, Java communicated appropriately and handled the situation well. She was paired with a doggy roommate, and may be a great candidate for a home with a well-matched canine companion. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs to make sure it’s a good fit!


If you enjoy watching a shy pup gain confidence and reveal her silly, playful side, Java may be exactly the kind of dog who steals your heart.

name: Lady
description_html:
Lady is the sweetest and most gentle girl you will ever meet.


She walks nicely on the leash and loves sniffing around. But her favorite thing? Being glued to you.

Lady just wants to be loved and receive all the butt scratches and belly rubs you can provide.


Come meet Lady today and be enchanted by her charisma.

name: Irie
description_html:
Irie is a sweet, affectionate girl who loves pets and makes the cutest biscuits when she's happy. She can get a little overstimulated during long cuddle sessions, but she’s gentle about letting you know.


Like many cats in the shelter right now, Irie developed an upper respiratory infection (URI), but she’s almost finished with treatment and is back to her loving self.


All Irie wants is a home where she can play, relax, and soak up the attention she loves. Come meet this biscuit-making sweetheart today!

name: Dreamcatcher
description_html:
Dreamcatcher's story began with a difficult start, but we're determined to help her find the happy ending she deserves.


She was brought to the shelter taped inside a box. Although she was overheated, she remained calm and allowed our staff to safely move her to a carrier. We may never understand how she ended up in that situation, but we do know she deserves so much better.


That's how she got her name. Dreamcatcher arrived at the shelter living a nightmare, and now we're hoping to help her find the loving home she's been dreaming of.


This beautiful girl is friendly, enjoys spending time with people, and will let you know when she needs a little space. She’s a confident cat who would thrive with someone who respects her boundaries and gives her the love she deserves.


Dreamcatcher has overcome so much and is ready for a safe, comfortable home. Come meet her today and help make her dream a reality!

name: Brandy
description_html:
Brandy has been a very good dog staying in the overflow crate room while space is tight at the shelter. She gets out for 4 walks a day and is a nice walking dog on a leash and very pleasant to be with. She enjoys yard time and hamming it up with her new human friends.


She's a very good girl for veterinary handling procedures. She's in good condition with a beautiful coat of fur. She's vaccinated and heart worm negative and will be spayed before a final adoption.


Come meet this very lovely girl today.

name: Darcy
description_html:
Foster Needed for Darcy 💙


Darcy is looking for a temporary hero!


This sweet kitten arrived at the shelter as a stray with his brother, Bingley. After recovering from an upper respiratory infection, we discovered Darcy has an eye injury that needs continued care while we determine the best treatment.


Despite everything, Darcy remains playful, curious, and incredibly affectionate. His eye condition doesn’t slow him down—he’s just a happy kitten who loves attention and playtime.


Now that Bingley has been adopted, Darcy is recovering without his brother by his side. A foster home would give him a quiet, comfortable place to heal and help him feel safe while he waits for his forever family. Could you open your home to this precious boy and help Darcy heal with love?

name: Zoink
description_html: This sweet, goofy meatball is looking for a home! Zoink gets super pumped to meet new people but easily calms down on his walk becoming a loose leash walker, happy to keep up with his human pal. Zoink’s love language? Butt scratches and words of affirmation, duh! He is motivated by sweet treats and even knows sit as he waits patiently to take his treat like the pure gentleman he is. Come meet him today at the shelter!

name: Spanky
description_html:
