Spanky is the total package: handsome, smart, playful, and full of personality! Shelter life has left him with plenty of pent-up energy, so he loves stretching his legs in the play yard, splashing in the pool, and exploring everything around him. He's even shown off his brave side by conquering the playscape and now happily hops up on shelter equipment with confidence!


Spanky is housetrained, treat-motivated, and enjoys checking in with his person during walks. He can pull on leash, especially when he's excited or spots other dogs, but he also has moments of walking nicely. With regular exercise, a consistent routine, and continued training in a home, his leash manners are likely to keep improving. Because he's still healing from a neck wound, shelter staff currently walk him using specialized equipment to keep him comfortable.


When meeting new people, Spanky appreciates a slow introduction, but he warms up quickly and becomes a very affectionate companion. If you're looking for an active, fun-loving dog who will happily join you for adventures, playtime, and maybe even a swim, Spanky is ready to be your best buddy!

name: Zaire
description_html:
If you're looking for an active, engaging companion with personality to spare, he’s ready to bring so much joy into your life.

This handsome guy loves to greet you with a happy hello and gets super excited to start his day. He harnesses up easily with a tasty treat and is a fantastic walking partner. While he’s eager to get moving, he shows off great loose-leash walking manners as soon as he hits his stride out on the trail.

With his playful energy, he’d make an incredible running buddy for outdoor adventures or a great candidate for fun doggy day outings. He thrives in the play yard and loves making the most of his outdoor time.

Ready for an adventurous, fun-loving best friend? Ask to meet him today!

name: Sampson
description_html:
Sampson doesn’t have any teeth, but that doesn’t keep him from eating dry food. He was living in the community before he was rescued and brought to AAS. He had terrible dental disease, so we moved him into foster care until he could have dental surgery (all of his teeth were extracted).

Sampson made a complete recovery, and must live indoors only. We don’t anticipate any future oral issues, but his eating habits and weight should be monitored to ensure that his mouth stays comfortable.

Sampson is very shy and timid, and tends to hide from humans. In his foster home, he could be petted in his safe place. He seemed to enjoy it, and was never aggressive, although sometimes he would hiss. He is a member of our Cactus Cats and is receiving confidence boosting. He is great with other cats, and should have a cat buddy. With time and patience, he will likely turn into a wonderful companion.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Sampson and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Chico
description_html:
Chico brings an impressive résumé of home experience! He has lived with dogs both big and small as well as a cat. He has been described as friendly with adults, children, visitors, and other animals.


Chico is house-trained and comfortable in a crate—he routinely stayed there while his family was away and slept there overnight. He knows 'sit' and has a long list of favorite activities, including fetch, tug-of-war, chase, walks, and chewing on bones. After the fun is over, he is happiest getting plenty of attention from his people.


Chico has also enjoyed playing with other dogs in shelter playgroup and may be a great candidate for a multi-pet home. Ask shelter staff about arranging a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs to make sure everyone’s play styles are a good match!


Chico can pull when he is excited and is frightened by thunderstorms, fireworks, gunshots, and other loud noises. A cozy retreat during storms—and a family ready for plenty of play and attention—would make him very happy.

name: Zera
description_html:
Looking for a soft and easy friend? Zera had a very large hanging mass removed and she's recovering well. She's spayed, heart worm negative and otherwise healthy. She goes at her own speed, in her own way, the way she's learned to adjust her body over time with well worn hips. She's the sweetest lady who loves being with one person, or being with a crowd - she loves all dogs, big and small. She has a great grasp of verbals too.


She's house trained and loves to pick her laying spots at home. She'll need a single story arrangement but she can handle curbs and a few stairs.

She'll need help getting in and out of a vehicle.


If you would like a soft older friend and don't mind eventually giving a full ride for this sweet caboose that will someday lead into the train station, but it's not here, not today, not near, we would like to talk to you. Reach out to her advocates at caring@classiccanines.org or apply on her link.


TAKE A LOOK AT HER "BEFORE" SHELTER VIDEO so you can appreciate how far she's come to be here today.

name: Josh
description_html:
Josh is a sweet, food-loving guy with great house manners and a softer side around other dogs. Shelter staff describe him as housetrained—he will hold it as long as possible until he can take care of business outside his kennel.


Josh is highly motivated by treats, which gives his future family a great tool for training. He can be enthusiastic and strong on leash, so continued work on walking skills will help turn outings into an even more enjoyable experience.


Josh has also shown promising social skills with other dogs. During shelter playgroup, he started out a little stiff and uncertain, but gradually relaxed enough to coexist comfortably and engage in some light, dainty play. He currently lives with a doggy roommate at the shelter, and has great potential to live with a compatible canine companion outside the shelter. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs. :)


Josh seems like the kind of dog who benefits from a little time to settle into a situation. Give him some treats, a chance to stretch his legs, and clear guidance, and this sweet boy is ready to keep learning.

name: Chandler
description_html:
Chandler is growing up in the shelter, and we’d love to see that change. 💙


He came in with his brother and has always been the shy one. New people can make him nervous, and he may hiss a little at first—but with patience and a gentle approach, he starts to open up. After a little time and calm conversation, he allowed pets and even enjoyed head rubs. He’s trying—he just needs someone willing to go at his pace.


Chandler isn’t looking for perfection, just a patient home where he can learn to trust and grow. 🐾

name: Hinata
description_html: Meet Hinata! This gorgeous fluffy German Shepherd is ready to steal hearts and find her forever home. She is a dream on the leash, walking calmly and politely by your side. She already knows "sit" and loves praise. Give her a toy and watch her light up, she would love a family who'll keep the toy basket stocked. Smart, sweet, and eager to please, Hinata is looking for a home where she can keep learning new tricks and shower her people with loyalty. Could that home be yours? Come meet Hinata today and see her beautiful fluffy face in person!

name: Boo (Petco)
description_html:
Boo is available for adoption at Petco Oak Hill. Go there to meet her today!


Pie & Boo are kittens that are still learning to be brave. They are on the shy side, so they could use some encouragement in a home setting. Snacks like Churu are always a great way to get to know them. And, they definitely love playtime! Pie & Boo would probably enjoy having a social and friendly feline or canine sibling to show them the ropes. They can be adopted together or separately!

name: Ray
description_html:
Please don’t let Koa and Ray grow up at the shelter. 💔


These two brown tabby brothers arrived with their siblings and have now been here for almost seven weeks.


They’re in that overlooked “teenage kitten” stage—no longer tiny babies, but not yet adults—and they keep getting passed by.💔 But they are sweet, playful, and love other cats. They just need a little time to warm up and show their personalities. We would love to see them adopted together, or into homes with another friendly cat.


Koa and Ray are ready for a real home🏡 —please don’t let them keep growing up in the shelter.

name: Koa
description_html:
Please don’t let Koa and Ray grow up at the shelter. 💔


These two brown tabby brothers arrived with their siblings and have now been here for almost seven weeks.

Koa and Ray are ready for a real home🏡 —please don’t let them keep growing up in the shelter.

description_html:
Pie is available for adoption at Petco Oak Hill. Go there to meet him today!


Pie & Boo are kittens that are still learning to be brave. They are on the shy side, so they could use some encouragement in a home setting. Snacks like Churu are always a great way to get to know them. And, they definitely love playtime! Pie & Boo would probably enjoy having a social and friendly feline or canine sibling to show them the ropes. They can be adopted together or separately!

name: Rosie
description_html:
Rosie is the biggest cuddle bug you'll ever meet and a total sucker for belly rubs. She gets along wonderfully with other dogs and kids (don't know about cats), making her a perfect fit for a busy, loving household.


She can be a little shy but her affectionate, gentle personality shines right through. Rosie is also crate trained, which makes settling into a new home that much easier. She is still working on her leash training but she is smart and eager to please.

name: Athena
description_html: Athena has never met a toy she doesn’t like. She is the most active of her siblings, but still loves to cuddle in sleep. Like her namesake, she is inquisitive and loves to play with anything she can find. She will make an excellent companion for multiple pet homes and/or people who love to play with their cat.

name: Maia
description_html: Maia is named after the goddess of spring because she is so sweet and loving. She loves to curl up in arms and laps for cuddles, but she also loves to play. Shoelaces and ribbons are a favorite!

name: Reed
description_html:
Reed is a sweet, handsome boy who was brought to AAS because he was begging for food and losing weight (we think that his owners abandoned him). Now living in foster care, he is a very low maintenance guy who enjoys laying around, and is delighted to get attention anytime.

Reed has a chill personality, so if you are looking for a companion that loves some nice pets, some good chin scratches, snacks, a quiet place to relax, and is self-reliant, he’s perfect. He prefers affection to playtime.

Reed doesn’t mind the large dog outside his door, so he has the potential to live with a calm dog. He is easy to handle and carry around, but prefers being on his own two feet. 

Reed has one quirk which is adorable: he doesn't require a lot of attention, but he does have opinions on how long you pet him. If you stop too soon, he’ll give a little hiss and a swat. Usually about three more pets and then he's good.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Reed and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Maluke
description_html:
All About Me:

I've lived well with male and female dogs, even the pushy ones

I'm very house trained

I know some cues like sit and down

I'm not fussy at all about my food

I like a relaxed lifestyle-a little sunning myself, a toy here or there, a little yard space is nice but walks are ok too-I'm never demanding, I'm easy to please

See me in action here


All About by Medical Status:

I'm a perfect size for me. I've had all my services completed.

I'm healthy AND I have a fresh dental for all those kisses!

I'm feeling on the top of the world but there's one thing missing..you!.

Reach out on my link to connect with handsome me!

name: Rocky
description_html: He is very playful and loves to bunny hop around the place. He runs really fast then forgets to slow down and bonks his head on walls and boxes then proceeds to not learn and do the same thing again. He loves toys and playing with your hands. He’s pretty good with touching and has been well desensitized. He’s cool with: face, tail, booty, belly, ears, and paw touches. He’s learning to control the force of his bites/nibbles and is slowly getting better at just licking and little nibbles. Same goes for the force of claw strength he’s slowly figuring out how much force is not harmful toward others. He behaves well with two ten year olds but hasn’t interacted with anyone younger than that. Very very cuddly, will waddle up to you and plop beside to pass out. Also vocal! He has a very high pitched meow that he is not shy to use, he doesn’t scream, but he does just like to talk to you and they’re very cute quiet meows. He is an incredibly sweet little boy.

name: Benito
description_html:
Meet Benito ~ he's sure to charm you with his soft soul.

Did you know that older dogs know between 80-165 words? Benito's first language is Spanish, and English is quickly become his second language, making him bilingual too.

Benito works so nicely with staff and volunteers, enjoying his outings and every comfort and affection given, bonding so nicely with the people who are so kind to him. He's very housetrained and great on a leash. Come meet him and see how you can be his VIP. He'll repay you many times over in affections and loyalty.

name: Botanicus
description_html:
Meet Botanicus, a gentle soul with a heart of gold who is looking for a quiet place to heal. Despite dealing with a rough skin condition that makes him look a bit scruffy right now, his sweet and loving personality shines through every single day. He does not let a little itchiness get in the way of being the best boy possible.

Botanicus is dog-friendly and loves the company of other pups, which might be just the comfort he needs while he gets better. He is looking for a temporary foster home where he can receive his medication, regular meals, and a cozy spot to rest his weary head. If you have some extra love and a corner of your home to spare, Botanicus will pay you back in endless gratitude and gentle tail wags.

name: Ray
description_html:
Some dogs wear their hearts on their sleeves, while others just need a little time. This sweet boy is still settling into shelter life and can be a bit shy, especially around the noise of barking dogs. When he's feeling unsure, he'll happily walk close behind his person, looking to them for reassurance.


Once he's away from the kennel environment, his personality starts to shine. He enjoys leisurely walks, taking time to sniff and explore, and checks in with his handler often. He's housetrained, walks nicely on a loose leash, and politely ignores both people and other dogs while out and about.


Toys aren't usually his thing—but hand him a shark stuffie and you'll see the cutest side of him! Watching him toss it into the air and catch it himself is guaranteed to make you smile. It's clear he's beginning to relax and come out of his shell a little more every day.


This gentle, medium-energy boy would thrive with a patient adopter who will let him settle in at his own pace. Give him a little time, a quiet place to decompress, and maybe a shark toy of his own, and you'll get to watch his confidence grow into something truly special.

name: Melvin
description_html:
Meet Melvin! This handsome 2-year-old boy is equal parts explorer and cuddlebug. On walks, Melvin enjoys taking his time to meander, sniff all the interesting smells, and happily say hello to new people along the way. He loves puzzle toys, outdoor adventures, and anything that keeps his curious mind busy.


Melvin is silly, sweet, affectionate, and very treat motivated, which makes bonding with him extra fun. One of his favorite things in the world? Butt scratches! They’re the quickest way to earn his happy wiggles. He’s also dog friendly and would enjoy having canine pals to hang out with.


If you’re looking for a lovable companion with a gentle spirit, playful personality, and lots of love to give, Melvin may be your perfect match!

name: Kayda
description_html: Kayda is a sweet young dog with a beautiful shiny coat. She is housetrained, strolls along easily on leash, and is dog friendly. Kayda loves to explore the playyard, run along the fence line with other friendly dogs, and entertain herself rolling in the grass. She is affectionate, curious and well behaved and a wonderful companion. Come meet this special girl!

name: Knox
description_html:
Knox is a very happy-go-lucky boy who was found on the streets wearing a green harness and dragging a green leash. We wish we knew his story. He stayed two months with a foster finder. while awaiting an intake appointment. He didn't live with other animals during that time. He stayed home alone 9-12 hours free roaming without ever causing any troubles.

Knox has been staying in the crate room at the shelter and frankly he's pretty over that arrangement. He's not a fan lately of returning to his crate. We can't blame him. It's not comfortable to stay in 24 hrs a day. And Knox likes his precious sleep - at about 8pm he simply reserves the right to rest and not have to get up and go out.

Knox had a fresh bath on 6/13 and his coat is so gorgeous and silky black. We would love to get him back into a cool and comfy home ASAP. See his intro video here

Are you ready to help Knox? Come in person between 11-6.

Offsite questions? Reach out to his advocates at caring@classiccanines.org

name: Kees
description_html:
Kees is a happy, playful pup who's always ready for his next adventure! Whether he's playing an enthusiastic game of fetch or strolling around campus, he brings a fun-loving spirit wherever he goes. He's a loose leash walker who enjoys stopping to sniff the flowers, and he frequently checks in with his handler, making walks a joy.


Kees appears to be housetrained and would thrive with an active family that enjoys getting outside. He's curious about people and other dogs and may pull a little to say hello, but he's eager to explore the world by your side. He's also working on keeping all four paws on the ground instead of jumping up to greet people, and he's making progress.


If you're looking for a playful, active companion who loves fetch, enjoys adventures, and is ready to keep learning, Kees can't wait to meet you!

name: Portia
description_html:
Portia is an easygoing, big, beautiful girl with a stunning brindle coat that is sure to turn heads wherever she goes. This gorgeous pup is the ultimate package, bringing the perfect balance of affection and playfulness to every single day. Whether you are looking for a fun-loving partner for backyard games or a sweet companion to cuddle up with on the couch, Portia fits the bill perfectly.

Not only is she incredibly charming, but she is also a smart cookie who already knows how to "shake" hands to introduce herself. Portia is ready to bring her bright spirit and endless affection to a forever home. Meet this wonderful girl today—she’s waiting to show you her favorite trick!

name: Tuxedo
description_html:
We love the style of Dr Tuxedo ~ sweet, gentle and easy - and such a people lover! He's been great for all of his vet handling procedures and a total sweetheart with the volunteers. He always carries a smile and he carries his people gently on the other end of the leash too! He casts his Dr spell on people and makes them swoon... .


He's heart worm negative and just had his immune system bolstered against doggie colds. He's neutered and he's RTG - "ready to go" for all opportunities! He just had his neuter and isn't play group tested yet. A doggie meet up can be arranged if needed, with a resident dog. Dr Tux is in the house - come meet him!

name: Pip Squeak
description_html:
Meet Pip Squeak! 🐾


Don't let his tiny size fool you—Pip Squeak has a big personality! As the little runt of the litter, he's learned that the best way to get attention is with his adorable, chatty meows. Whether he's asking for cuddles, reminding you it's mealtime, or simply telling you about his day, Pip always has something to say.


This sweet little guy loves to play just as much as he loves to snuggle. When the zoomies are over, you'll often find him curled up with his foster siblings, proving that life is always better with a friend nearby. He's a champion cuddler with a gentle heart and would thrive in a home with another friendly cat to be his built-in best buddy.


Pip Squeak is also a litter box superstar and is ready to bring endless purrs, playful antics, and loving companionship to his forever family. If you're looking for a tiny shadow who will happily chat with you and then curl up by your side (or with his feline friend), Pip Squeak is your guy! ❤️


Check out my foster mom’s insta: @jamiethekittenfoster_atx for more pics and vids!

name: Fusilli
description_html:
Meet Fusilli! If you’re searching for a sweet, soulful companion who shines wherever she goes, Fusilli is guaranteed to capture your heart.

While she can be a little shy at first, it only takes a few quiet minutes and a couple of yummy treats for her to warm right up.

Fusilli harnesses up easily, walks like a pro on the leash, and even loves keeping up with a fun little trot. She also happens to be deaf, but you’d hardly notice because she is so tuned into her human and handles the world like an absolute supermodel.

If you’re ready to welcome a polite, gorgeous, and loving girl into your home, ask to meet Fusilli today!

name: Kiwi
description_html:
Kiwi was an outdoor kitty in a rural area who ended up at the shelter when her caregiver passed away. She's knows the kindness of strangers and appreciates a soft approach.

She loves the company of other cats and should go to a home with cat friends to help her ease into a new space. Kiwi could especially benefit from having a confident, social cat to model brave behaviors for her.

Kiwi would do well in a low traffic home without small children; someplace she can come out of her shell at her own pace.

Kiwi is a Cactus Cat for her extreme shyness so she needs a cat savvy adopter to help her on the next leg of her journey.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Kiwi and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Mabel
description_html:
Mabel is the sweetest little soul and the perfect size for just about any home. She lost her lifelong home when her owner was no longer able to care for her. This gentle girl has embraced her new beginning with grace and is now thriving in foster care while she waits for her very own forever family.

She has a calm, easygoing personality and enjoys the simple things in life, especially neighborhood walks where she can quietly take in all the sights. She’s completely house-trained, has wonderful leash manners, knows cues like "sit" and "come," and can comfortably stay home on her own for a few hours. She may be a little shy at first, but she quickly warms up and shows her sweet, affectionate personality. Mabel also enjoys car rides, is patient during bath time, and has settled in nicely with her two canine foster siblings, including one much larger than she is. She would likely enjoy a home with another friendly dog. Her experience with cats and children is currently unknown.

Classic Canines has taken care of all of Mabel’s veterinary needs. She is spayed, fully vaccinated, and up to date on all recommended medical care, making her ready for her next chapter.

Mabel has so much love and loyalty left to give and is ready for a family who will cherish the gentle soul she is. If you’re looking for a devoted friend to enjoy life’s simple moments with, Mabel may be the one you’ve been waiting for.

name: Oakley
description_html:
Oakley is a mature pup who's the perfect size for all of life's adventures, whether that's a road trip, a neighborhood stroll, or relaxing at home. It’s impossible not to love his expressive ears and soft fur.

Oakley’s ideal day would be full of chew toys and soaking up the sunshine on the patio. He's just as happy enjoying a quiet afternoon by your side as he is heading out to explore.

In foster, Oakley has been showing us he loves a game of fetch with balls and his stuffed animals. He has the ‘bring it back’ part down.

Oakley is a wonderful housemate. He's potty trained, crate trained, and walks well on a leash. He enjoys the company of other doggy friends after proper introduction and has an easygoing personality. Even during a busy family dinner with kids running around, Oakley settled in quietly and took it all in stride.

Oakley is respectful of his human roommates’ belongings and sticks to his own toys for chewing. When left in his crate he relaxes for a nap.

Oakley can be a little startled by loud noises such as the garbage truck and hesitant of strangers entering the house, but with reassurance he continues to build confidence. He is very food motivated which makes training sessions with him easy. Currently, he knows the commands ‘sit’ and ‘crate time’ but is catching on quickly to others.

If you're looking for a sweet, well-mannered companion who's ready to be your best adventure buddy and your favorite patio lounging partner, Oakley could be your perfect match!

name: Oliver
description_html:
Oliver is the kind of dog who quietly works his way into your heart. He's been a favorite of mine since he first arrived at the shelter, and it's been so rewarding to watch his confidence grow with every outing.

If there's one way to win Oliver over, it's with a toy! Fetch is his absolute favorite game, and toys are definitely his love language. He happily brings them back without being grabby, and he loves carrying one along on walks like his own little comfort stuffie. While treats aren't a huge motivator for him, toss him a ball and you've got his full attention.

Oliver is very housetrained, walks nicely on a loose leash with only mild pulling, and enjoys taking his time to sniff and explore while checking in often with his person. He's neutral around other dogs and people, making him an easy companion for adventures. He even seems happy to coexist with other dogs rather than feeling the need to be the center of attention.

Oliver can be a little shy when meeting new people, so he appreciates a patient, go-slow introduction. Once he knows you, though, he's eager to head out for fun. He's an independent guy who doesn't demand constant affection, but he'll happily share his love through games of fetch and quiet companionship.

If you're looking for a playful, housetrained, toy-loving buddy who will happily carry his favorite toy wherever life takes him, Oliver just might be your perfect match.

name: Isabelly
description_html:
This little one took a few days to find her confidence, but once she did, her personality came shining through! At just a couple months old, she's already proven she can hold her own against our resident 9-month-old kitten, the two of them tear around the room like they've been best friends forever. When she finally wears her big foster brother out, she's perfectly happy entertaining herself with toys on her own.


She warmed up to her human foster family right on schedule, and now she's all about the cuddles. Curling up on laps and settling into arms like she owns the place. Sweet, playful, independent, and affectionate, she truly has it all.


She would thrive in a home with another cat to keep her busy, but she's confident and self-sufficient enough to shine as an only pet too. If you're looking for a kitten with a big personality in a tiny package, she just might be your perfect match!

name: Gumbo
description_html:
Meet Gumbo 🥘 — a big-hearted, affectionate guy who is ready to trade shelter life for a comfy couch. His previous family described him as "the most loving and affectionate" dog and shared that they had to surrender him only because they could no longer keep him where they lived. They reported that he was house-trained, friendly with people, and happiest spending time with his family.

While shelter life has been tough on Gumbo, volunteers consistently see a different dog once he's out of the kennel. He enjoys sniffy walks, kiddie pool time, treats, pets, and relaxing in the AC. One volunteer even brought him to a meeting, where he politely greeted everyone, settled in, and spent most of the time snoozing. He's easy to handle, enjoys affection, and has earned a reputation as a total sweetheart.

If you’re looking for a loyal companion who loves people, enjoys the simple things in life, and is happiest close to his humans, Gumbo may be the perfect recipe. ❤️

name: Pinecone
description_html:
If you have a lot of experience with cats, then Pinecone might be perfect for you! She was living as a community cat in an unsafe environment, and she and several other kittens (including Mistletoe) were rescued and brought to AAS.

Pinecone is not comfortable with humans, so she will need time and patience to adjust to a new household and to new people. She is very scared in the shelter, so we would LOVE to see her out of the kennel, either through adoption or foster.

Pinecone is wonderful with other cats, and needs to have a cat buddy in her quiet home, someone she can play and cuddle with.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Pinecone and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Mistletoe
description_html:
Mistletoe is looking for a patient human who is very experienced with cats! She was living in an unsafe environment, and she and several other kittens (including Pinecone) were rescued and brought to AAS.

Not yet comfortable with people, Mistletoe will need lots of time to adjust to a new household. She is very scared in the shelter, so we would LOVE to see her out of the kennel, either through adoption or foster.

Mistletoe is wonderful with other cats, and needs to have a cat buddy in her quiet home, someone she can play and cuddle with.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Mistletoe and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Pepper
description_html:
Pepper isn't spicy at all! She's a soft natured, affectionate lady of wisdom who misses the comforts of home. She loves when people talk to her and give her pets and cuddles.

Pepper is very house trained and a pro at staying home alone with her squeaky toy friends. She's an expert car rider too. She's lived with dogs before and shared kennel space with a dog at the shelter.

Pepper is a healthy lady, heart worm negative, vaccinated and spayed and ready to leave right away for adoption and foster opportunities. She can't wait to meet you and get back to cozy home living.

Meet her onsite or reach out to her advocates at caring@classiccanines.org with questions.

name: Bodi
description_html:
Bodi is the perfect mix of adventure buddy and laid-back companion. He's housetrained, walks beautifully on leash once he's past the excitement of leaving his kennel, and loves taking his time to sniff and explore the world around him. He may pull a bit at first, but quickly settles into an easy, loose-leash walk with plenty of check-ins with his handler.


This handsome boy knows "sit," enjoys tasty treats, and absolutely melts for a good head scratch. While he may bark as he exits his kennel, he remains neutral to both people and other dogs on walks, making him an enjoyable companion for outings. Bodi especially loves spending time in the play yard, where his playful side shines.


If you're looking for a medium-energy dog who's affectionate without being clingy, enjoys exploring, and is ready to join you on walks or relaxing afternoons, Bodi is ready to meet you!

name: Annie
description_html: Meet Annie, the World's Cutest House Panther! Annie was found in May hiding in a car engine after a night of storms, just one pound & very scared!  She has spent a few weeks growing in size & confidence in foster care & is ready for her own furrever family. Annie is a true house panther, always active & exploring, snuggling with her people when she is worn out. Annie likes other kitties & will do best with another playful kitten or cat.

name: Amor
description_html:
Amor means "love" and that's how she's been described since the moment she was found alone and brought to safety. She's mannered and calm, affectionate and mellow. And she loves walks, is always nice on a leash, and passes other dogs well. She loves a good roll in the grass, showing off cues here and there, and especially taking part in perimeter and squirrel yard patrols.


Amor spent some time in a volunteer sleep over and did well sharing space with a cat for a limited few days. We always recommend slow introductions.


Amor is RTG - "ready to go" - she's vaccinated, spayed and heart worm negative and all you need to do is decide if she is "the one" you've been waiting for. Visit her onsite.

name: Bergamot
description_html:
Bergamot is a sweet, kiss-giving pup with a gentle heart and a playful side. He recently spent time with a family that included a 14-year-old and a 9-year-old, and he was affectionate with everyone—soliciting pets, handing out kisses, and being especially gentle with the younger child.


Bergamot also has some excellent dog-social skills. In shelter playgroup, he offered polite sniffy greetings, threw play bows, and settled into soft, appropriate play. Pushier dogs can be a little much for him, but he handled that beautifully by tolerating the interaction and helping de-escalate rather than escalating it himself. He has great potential to live with a well-matched canine companion, so ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs.


Bergamot can pull on leash when he’s excited, but he is manageable, and shelter staff have consistently described him as friendly and very sweet. He also appears motivated to keep his kennel clean, which may be a promising sign for house-training.


If you’re looking for an affectionate dog who enjoys both people and canine company, Bergamot might be just the right mix of gentle and playful.

name: Damon
description_html:
Damon is a sweet, adventurous pup who's always ready to head out and explore. He starts walks with plenty of enthusiasm and can pull on leash at first, but he settles into enjoying all the interesting sights and smells along the way. He's curious about other dogs and likes to check them out as he passes by.


Damon is very food motivated, making treats a great way to build his skills and strengthen your bond. He also loves the water, so splashy adventures could quickly become one of his favorite activities. One of Damon's quirks is that he may chew on his leash when he's excited, so bringing along a toy to redirect him can help set him up for success.


With an active family that can provide continued training, enrichment, and plenty of opportunities to explore, Damon has all the makings of a fun and loyal companion.

name: Niomi (petco)
description_html:
Niomi is available for adoption at Petco Lakeline! Go there to meet her.


Niomi is a retired momma cat! She decided to have her kittens on a nice person's patio and they cared for her while she nursed her babies. Now her kittens are off living their dreams while Niomi is still searching for her home. This is a recurring theme in the life of many young female cats. Niomi is very outgoing, confident, affectionate and loves pets. She can be playful and enjoys space to romp around. Niomi may do best in a home where she can be the #1 diva and get your full attention. Adopt this special lady today!

name: Brock
description_html: Brock is a shy guy that has a very sweet, soft meow and purr that lets you know when he is hungry or wants attention. He likes to play fetch with his favorite stuffed mouse, is litter box trained, eats a mix of crunchy and wet food, neutered, microchipped, and vaccinated. At his foster family's house, he has lived with dogs, a cat, and respectful older kids. While he can tolerate dogs, he would really love a friendly resident cat and family to call his forever home.

name: Taz
description_html:
Meet Taz!


Taz is a lovable, happy-go-lucky young pup who is ready to find his forever family! At just over a year old, this handsome boy is full of energy, affection, and enthusiasm for life. His favorite things include long walks, chewing on his favorite bones, and soaking up attention from the people he loves.


Taz is a friendly, social dog who enjoys meeting new people and has done well with both men and women. He’s lived with a young infant and is described as loving and sweet. One of his favorite ways to show affection is by giving hugs, and he’s always excited to be close to his people.


This smart boy already knows several commands, including sit, stay, and shake. He also has excellent mealtime manners—he can patiently wait for permission before eating until he hears his release cue. Taz is house-trained and crate-trained.


Taz enjoys playing with other dogs. He’s friendly when approached by strangers on walks and generally loves being part of the action.


Thunderstorms and fireworks can make Taz nervous, and car rides aren’t his favorite activity, but with patience and reassurance he settles back in. Because he’s still a young, energetic dog, he’ll thrive with a family that can provide regular exercise and plenty of love.


Taz’s family is making the difficult decision to rehome him due to military housing breed restrictions, not because of any fault of his own. They describe him as very loving, playful, happy, sweet, and devoted.


If you’re looking for a loyal companion who loves hugs, adventures, and being part of the family, Taz may be the perfect match for you!

name: Annabelle
description_html:
I'm Annabelle.... I love being with everyone, big and little, humans and dogs. I love to take walks too.

I'm the perfect companion! I'm affectionate and I love to be petted around the ears! Here I am with my friends here when I was in the shelter.

Now I'm in a foster home with other dogs, and I'm loving it, but I would also be fine with being your only canine companion. I'm so patient for bathing and I'm easy to care for. I'm housetrained and crate trained. I'm a lot of fun and I keep up with the crew. I have a clean bill of health too! I hope to meet you soon!

Click on my link to meet me.

Love, Annabelle

name: Cassia
description_html:
Cassia is a beautiful, sweet, and shy girl. She arrived at AAS after being rescued from a community environment. Upon arrival, the DVM noticed that she has chronic but stable eye conditions, which are likely the result of previous URI and ulcerated corneas. Her right eye remains dilated and her left eye has collapsed a bit. No treatment is required at this time, and her eyes are not painful. They should be monitored for any sudden changes as there is the potential for glaucoma to develop.

As a member of our Cactus Cats program, Cassia is becoming more comfortable with people. She tends to hide, but likes to be petted. She is not aggressive, she’s just learning to appreciate everything that humans are good for.

Cassia will do best in a home with a cat buddy. She was friends with Bee in their foster home.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Cassia and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Piggy
description_html:
Piggy is the total package—sweet, silly, playful, and guaranteed to keep you smiling. With his giant expressive ears and happy personality, it's hard not to fall in love with him!

This happy boy is a dream to take out and about. He's a loose leash walker, rides politely in the car, and stays calm around just about everything. On his day out, he happily ignored other dogs, adults, children, squirrels, and even ducks, preferring to spend his time sniffing and exploring.

Piggy loved meeting new people and greeted everyone with a wagging tail and playful bows, soaking up all the pets. Once back at the house, he spent hours happily playing with toys—his absolute favorite! Whether you want to play tug or toss a toy, or let him entertain himself, Piggy is always ready for fun. He's also very treat-motivated, making him eager to learn.

He appears to be housetrained, had no accidents, and didn't try to get into anything he shouldn't. If you're looking for a goofy, easygoing companion who loves adventures, toys, and making people laugh, Piggy is ready to be your new best friend.

Outing:

I took him to spend the day with me at my house. We went for a walk in the neighborhood in the morning and then the rest of the day I scattered all of the dog toys around the house and he got to play with all of them. He was so happy and wagging his tail while he got to play with all of the toys. He also enjoyed some frozen dog, friendly enrichment. I learned that he does not resource guard, food or toys at all, even though he get super excited about both. He is definitely an active dog, but I don’t think he needs someone that’s going to go on tons of hikes and super long walk, rather he just really likes to play with toys, play fetch, etc. He does enjoy walks and is very good on leash - no reactivity at all. He also seems so much more confident with handling then he did when he first arrived to the shelter and I think would make a fantastic dog for doggy day out. He’s incredibly sweet and sat in the backseat of my car very politely. When I brought him back to his kennel at the end of the day, he greeted his sweet mate with a kiss, and it was super cute.

name: Bruno
description_html:
Bruno is a happy, wiggly boy who's always ready for his next adventure! He has great leash manners and enjoys checking in with his person throughout walks, making him a fun and engaging companion. While he may occasionally get excited by squirrels or become a little jumpy in new situations, he's easily redirected with a few treat tosses and quickly gets back on track.


Smart, athletic, and highly treat motivated, Bruno would likely love learning new tricks or even trying agility. His playful personality shines through, and he enjoys meeting people and other dogs with friendly curiosity. He also loves being brushed and has a cuddly side once it's time to relax.


Bruno is looking for an active home that will enjoy exploring the world with him, continue his positive training, and appreciate his sweet, eager-to-please personality. If you're searching for a playful best friend with brains, heart, and lots of potential, Bruno is ready to meet you!

name: Diamond
description_html:
Meet Diamond!

Diamond is a sweet, gentle girl with a heart as precious as her name. After spending more than two years in a loving home, she is looking for a new family through no fault of her own after her owner had to move and was unable to take her along.


This friendly pup has lived successfully in an apartment and is both house-trained and paper-trained, with no history of accidents in the home. She has wonderful indoor manners, making her an easy companion to have around the house.

When left alone, Diamond can be trusted to relax freely in the home and has not shown any destructive behaviors.


Diamond's favorite activities include playing fetch, chasing toys, chewing on bones, and carrying around her beloved squeaky toys. She also knows several commands, including sit, stay, come, and shake, and enjoys spending quality time with her people.


Those who know Diamond describe her as incredibly sweet and friendly. She has done well with children and has a calm, gentle nature. While she can be shy around men and may take some time to warm up to unfamiliar people, patience and kindness help her build confidence. She may bark when someone new enters the home and can be a little nervous when approached by strangers on walks, but she has never shown any aggression.


Diamond is also cooperative with handling, allowing baths, nail trims, and being picked up, although she can be a little nervous during bath time. Loud noises and vacuums can be scary for her, so she appreciates a family that understands her sensitive side and can help her feel safe and secure.


She would thrive in a patient, loving home that can give her the time and companionship she deserves. If you're looking for a loyal, gentle companion who enjoys playtime, quiet evenings, and being close to her family, Diamond may be the perfect match for you.


Come meet Diamond and discover what a gem she truly is!

name: Zayda
description_html:
Zayda is a sweet, playful puppy with some excellent real-life skills already under her belt. Shelter staff describe her as house-trained and a loose-leash walker, making her a great candidate for someone looking for a dog who already has a head start on home manners.


Zayda can be a little shy when she first enters a new situation, but once she feels comfortable, her playful side comes out. During her initial shelter playgroup evaluation, she greeted the other dogs appropriately, relaxed into loose, happy zoomies, and began actively inviting them to play. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs to make sure everyone is a good fit!

name: Princesa
description_html:
Meet Princesa ~ life tossed her a curve ball when she lost her longtime home due to her owner's hardship, marking the start of a major transition in life.

Princesa is affectionate, house trained, crate trained and walks nicely on a leash. She loves taking walks. She has lived with a male dog about the same size as her for part of her life and shared a kennel at the shelter with a male dog See them together in their kennel here . She's now in a foster home with another dog. She co-exists nicely and respectfully.

She's spayed, vaccinated, heart worm negative. She checks all the boxes of an easy care friend for your home, just click on her inquiry link to check in with her foster provider directly.

She's advocated for by her friends at ClassicCaninesATX who give an extra level of care and support for the mature dogs that are often the most rounded choices for so many homes.

name: Artie
description_html: Artie is one of the happiest boys you will ever meet! He loves people and other dogs and will wag his tail so hard you won't doubt it. He loves to play but will also settle down when it's time. He does great in a crate and will even go in on his own. He already knows how to sit and recently learned how to go up the stairs. Don't let the muscles fool you - he is a sensitive boy who is still learning that the world doesn't have to be such a scary place. All he really wants is someone to love and cuddle with him!

name: Miss Mari
description_html: Mariah is a super shy young girl who was being cared for in the community. She was initially shy and friendly for pets in the shelter, but the stress is now getting to her. She is likely to hiss initially and need a slow start. You can make friends with her through Churu! Mariah will need a patient foster or adopter with a starter space with appropriate hiding spots for this timid girl. We can’t wait to see her blossom in a home and get braver every day!

name: Bunuelo
description_html:
Meet Bunuelo! Just like the golden-brown, fried pastry he’s named after, this handsome pup is as sweet as they come. With a warm, honey-colored coat that matches his sunny personality, Bunuelo is guaranteed to brighten every single day. 

He’s the total package: very playful when it’s time to romp around, but an absolute world-class cuddler when you’re ready to relax on the couch. This smart guy already knows "sit" and is always eager to show off his good manners for a tasty treat! Ready to add a little extra sweetness to your life? Bunuelo can’t wait to meet you!

name: Lalita
description_html:
Lalita is a sweet, affectionate girl who doesn't take long to make a new friend. She quickly warmed up and happily stayed close for cuddles and pets, showing off her cheerful, easygoing personality. She enjoys checking in with her handler during walks, loves exploring and sniffing, and only shows mild pulling on leash.


Lalita has a high interest in squirrels and may pull to chase them, but she redirects well with treats and gets right back to enjoying her walk. If you're looking for a happy companion who loves affection, treats, and spending time with her people, Lalita is ready to meet you!

name: Honey Bee
description_html:
Honey Bee is shy when first meeting new people, but she soon decides you are friends and that is where the fun begins!

Honey Bee is hilarious, zooming around a play yard while smacking her own face with a toy. She loves the kiddie pools especially in the Texas heat! Once she burns off a little energy she’s more than content to just come lay down by her human friends and hang out, occasionally asking for a few pets.

Honey Bee is constantly exploring and smelling for new things. Like a real little bumble bee, Honey Bee goes from tree to tree, grass patch to grass patch and sniffs all of the messages the world has to offer. This is her favorite - the walkies.

Honey Bee seems very house trained and is ready to find a forever family!

We'd love to learn more about her in foster care, or find her a forever home!

name: Cassandra
description_html: Miss Cassie is the sweetest cuddliest floppiest little kitty in the world, she loves to play and then cuddle up with you when she's all tired out!

name: B.B.
description_html:
Meet BB — the curious, confident little explorer of the litter.


BB was born to Salem, our beloved backyard community cat, and we have cared for him since the very day he was born. From the start, BB has had a spark about him. He is adventurous, observant, and always the first to investigate something new. He looks at you with these knowing little eyes, like he fully understands what is going on and has a few opinions about it.


BB is sweet, gentle, litter box trained, and very comfortable with people. He has a playful, leader-of-the-pack personality and loves trying new things, exploring his surroundings, and being part of whatever is happening. He is also a little talkative and will happily “talk back” when you speak to him, which makes him feel more like a tiny roommate than just a cat.


He is one of those kittens who is impossible not to get attached to. BB King has been one of our favorites in the litter because he has so much personality, confidence, and charm. He is fixed, vaccinated, and ready for his forever home.


BB deserves a wonderful home where he can be loved, spoiled, explored with, and appreciated for the special little cat he is.

name: Tyson
description_html: Tyson is great on a leash and loves a walk! He loves to give cuddles at any time. He loves toys and knows "sit" and "stay" in Spanish. He's very friendly and affectionate! Very good boy.

name: Penny
description_html:
Penny is a boss lady who knows what she wants! And she wants out of this kennel. She also wants to be your only special feline and get all your attention. Penny is a happy girl when she has her special someone to follow around. She loves to watch you cook and go about your daily tasks (aka make sure you're doing it right). This smart girl knows her name and responds to little "kissy" sounds.

Penny is unimpressed with our service here at the shelter, so she may not show you her best side in a kennel. We'd love to see her in a foster home if she doesn't get adopted ASAP!

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Penny and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Opal
description_html:
Hi, I'm Opal!


I arrived to the shelter needing a helping hand and a place to stay for a fresh start in life. I'm in a great foster home now where I found other fur friends, small and big, and we like to kick up together, and lay down together. I love having friends.


Don't let anyone tell you my age is a barrier - I'm here to prove my spirit and will, I have a lot of life left to give. I'm a joyful lady. You know what else? I'm a healthy lady too. My people say I qualify for a little nip and tuck of my girly parts and then I'll be ready for 'doption. That means I could be coming your way soon.


See my short introduction video here in the shelter before my big makeover. Now I feel so liberated. I'm nice and cool for the summer weather.


See you soon?

name: Fuji
description_html:
Fuji is an active, curious boy who enjoys getting out to explore the world with his nose. He appears to be housetrained and loves spending his walks sniffing new scents and investigating his surroundings. He's also food motivated, making treats a great way to build a bond with him.


While he enjoys time in the play yard, he's more interested in exploring than playing and will happily let you know when he's ready to head out.


Fuji is resistant to returning to his kennel, so patience, high-value treats, and positive reinforcement go a long way. With continued training, structure, and regular exercise, Fuji has all the potential to become a wonderful companion for an active home ready to help him build confidence and polish his leash manners.

name: Athena
description_html:
Athena arrived at AAS with a large number of other cats from the same situation (Samantha also came from here). She is very shy and scared, and tends to run and hide when humans approach (she has not been aggressive).

Given where she was living, Athena probably didn’t receive any attention or socialization. She needs an experienced cat person to give her the necessary time and patience for her to feel comfortable in her surroundings.

Athena’s best situation will be in a quiet home with at least one cat buddy. That friend can help her adjust and feel more confident.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Athena and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Luna
description_html:
Don’t let her Resting Mad Face fool you - Luna is a sweet and playful pint-size princess! She loves to play with her spring toys, have her neck rubbed, and to watch the summer bugs at the window while you work.

She may have had a difficult start to life, and is a bit on the sensitive side when in a new place or meeting new people. But don’t worry, once she’s settled she’ll let you know she runs the place! Unsure how she might be with other cats, but she definitely doesn’t want to share her space with a dog. Will she find her forever home with you?

name: Lupe Fiasco
description_html:
Lupe is a 5-year-old sweetheart with a gentle soul and a heart full of love. This handsome boy already knows "sit" and "shake," and he's happy to show off his excellent manners for treats and praise. He absolutely loves people and is happiest when he's snuggled up beside you, soaking up affection and handing out plenty of kisses in return.


Despite being a big dog, Lupe is wonderfully easy to walk on a leash and enjoys getting out for strolls with his favorite humans. He's the kind of companion who is content to be by your side, whether you're relaxing at home, taking a walk around the neighborhood, or settling in for a cozy evening on the couch.


Lupe has the easygoing personality to thrive in either a house or an apartment, as long as he has people to love and a comfortable place to call his own.


If you're looking for a loyal, affectionate best friend who will greet you with kisses and stay close for snuggles, Lupe may be the perfect match for you.

name: Aries
description_html: Aries is quite curious and vocal when he sees other dogs, often wagging his tail in hopes of joining a playgroup. Beyond socializing, he absolutely loves the water. If a pool isn't available, he will try to create one using his drinking buckets. Once his social and splashing needs are met, he is very happy to come over for human snuggles.

name: Contexto
description_html:
Contexto is a total dreamboat - a smiley, handsome guy who will sweep you off your feet if you let him.

He’s a little shy at first, but warms up really quickly. He’s a calm and easy leash-walker, checking in with his person often. He’s an ace at commands like “sit” and “shake”, but he also has a silly, playful side. He loves belly rubs, snuggling, and most of all just being near his people.

name: Phil
description_html: Cuddly, inquisitive Phil will be a wonderful addition to any home. Phil is quiet, playful, friendly, eats well, enjoys the company of our small dogs and is curious about our very old cat. (She's a bit pet fussy.) Phil was treated for an eye issue which is stable now, he's been neutered and is ready to go to his forever home. Phil has not been around kids but he's very friendly so he should do well.

name: Haisai
description_html:
Haisai is a smart, polished companion with an outstanding training foundation and a playful side waiting just beneath the surface. A shelter volunteer described him as a perfect loose-leash walker who naturally heels beside his person and regularly checks in without being asked. He is polite and attentive—qualities that make spending time with him a genuine pleasure.


Haisai has an impressive repertoire of skills. He knows 'sit', 'down', 'stay', 'come', 'shake', and 'high five', and loves to show off on the shelter’s agility course. He is highly motivated by treats and eager to work with his person, making training a wonderful way to bond with him.


Haisai is housetrained and familiar with a crate routine. His former caregiver reported that he had no accidents, stayed in a crate while home alone, and slept there overnight. He even understands 'go home' as a cue to enter his kennel. His favorite things include walks, squeaky toys, chewing on bones, exploring a yard, and receiving plenty of scratches and pets.


Haisai also has experience playing and socializing with other dogs. During shelter playgroup, he began somewhat stiff and nervous but soon relaxed enough to enjoy zoomies and was successfully paired with a doggy roommate. He can become vocal or over-excited when he sees dogs through kennel gates or other barriers, so introductions should take place thoughtfully outside that environment. Haisai has potential to live with a well-matched canine companion—ask shelter staff about arranging a meet-and-greet with your resident dog!


Haisai loves his people and may cry or bark when left alone for extended periods. A family that can provide companionship, enrichment, and gradual practice with being alone will help him settle successfully. He is also frightened by loud noises and would appreciate a quiet retreat when the world gets noisy.


For someone seeking an exceptionally well-trained dog who can join them for walks, agility, playtime, and plenty of affection, Haisai has so much to offer! Come meet him today.

name: Blue
description_html: Blue is a perfect angel who found his way to the shelter through no fault of his own. He is extremely house-trained- saving his business all day until a volunteer of staff member can take him out for his 20 minutes of freedom. He’s extremely friendly to anyone he interacts with, playful and well-mannered on a leash. His intake notes even say he loved successfully with two cats! It’s obvious this boy has been loved before and is looking forward to being someone’s forever companion again. Come meet him at the shelter today!

name: Hazel
description_html:
Hi everyone! I'm Hazel. My people had a misfortune and I was alone so I was brought to this new place. The people here are very nice to me, they treat me like the grand lady I am, making me feel really special with the prettiest collar and nice bedding for my woman's size frame. People tell me I have the prettiest eyes, hazel of course. I love to meet people and 'specially like to go for short walks and lounge in the pool. I'm also really good at keeping those dang lizards away from the place too! My friends here said I'm on track to graduate from the senior class but I must find a suitable life mission--I said "I know, I'm trying really hard". So will you please consider me for an indoors job? I'm spayed, heart worm negative and ready to leave as fast as your vehicle travels and I'll keep the little critters away from your place too. Hope to see you soon - with much love waiting, Hazel.

See my short IG video here.

name: Precious
description_html:
Meet Precious — and yes, her name fits her perfectly.


Precious is a 3-year-old sweetheart who is learning that life can be soft, safe, and full of love. Her previous owner made the heartbreaking decision to surrender her due to financial hardship, and before coming to the shelter, Precious spent much of her time the last 3 months living in a backyard. Because of that, new people and environments can feel a little overwhelming at first.


Give her a little patience, though, and you’ll quickly see her true personality shine through. Once Precious feels comfortable, she transforms into an affectionate cuddle bug who will happily curl up in your lap and soak up every bit of love you offer.


She’s a low-energy girl who seems content with the simple things — a comfy bed, a calm home, gentle companionship, and someone she can trust. She also appears to be house trained, making her an easy companion for a lucky adopter.


Precious is looking for a family that understands that some dogs just need a little extra time to bloom. In return, she’ll give you quiet loyalty, sweet cuddles, and a bond that feels truly special.

If you’re searching for a gentle soul to love, Precious may be the perfect addition to your home.

name: Molly
description_html: Molly is a sweet, smiley dog who was found roaming near Research Blvd. She adapted to the foster home very quickly and is house trained! She loves belly rubs and is always excited to meet new people. Molly would be an amazing family dog. She loves outside and would be very happy with a yard to play in!

name: Melos
description_html:
After years of a comfy home life, Melos has found himself at the shelter when his former owner wasn't allowed to have pets at their new home. While the shelter was loud and scary at first, he is finding his confidence again and has really started to come out of his shell!


Melos loves walks and is fantastic on leash, showing no prey drive or strong pulling. With humans he's not jumpy or all over you, he likes to be a coexister. He seeks affection from all his friends! He loves a kiddie pool to beat the Texas heat but will also settle for a squeaky pig dog toy to pass the time. He mainly loves to just explore all the smells and people watch when he can. Melos also loves a good treat or two. Melos is also very housetrained!


Come meet Melos today!

name: Finley
description_html:
Meet Finley! 🐾 (Or as we like to call him: our “TEMU Shiba Inu” 🐕) Finley is an approximately 1-year-old medium/large mixed breed dog with a sweet personality and so much love to give. After being found as a stray and likely dumped by his previous owners, he’s been working hard learning what it means to feel safe, cared for, and part of a home. 🏡


In his time with us, Finley has made incredible progress:

• Potty-trained and house-broken

• Walks well on a leash, knows “sit,” and is learning additional commands

• Does well when left alone: is non-destructive and minimal barking

• Crate-trained

• Dog friendly and would likely do well with children (unsure about cats)

• Fully vaccinated, microchipped, and neutered


Finley has overcome a lot already, and now he’s ready for a forever home where he can continue to thrive. He’s goofy, loving, eager to learn, and truly deserves a family of his own! 🧡

name: Bravo
description_html:
Per his previous foster: Bravo started out as a special-needs foster after recovering from a fractured femur. He’s young and is still working on socializing with other dogs, but he’s making great progress!

He’s incredibly sweet, loves people, and is highly food- and treat-motivated, which makes training fun. He’s potty trained and is continuing to learn basic manners and obedience. He walks well on a leash, though he occasionally gets excited and may accidentally trip you. Like any puppy, he’s still learning boundaries, including not jumping on people and resisting the urge to sniff everything in sight.

He’s still young, so he’ll need continued training, patience, and socialization, but he’s come a long way already and improves a little more every day. He may take a bit longer to pick up new things than some puppies, but he’s eager to learn and has a wonderful personality.

name: Cayenne
description_html:
Cayenne is a spicy little pepper, just like her name suggests. She's lived outdoors and may make an excellent mouser or hunter, protecting your property from unwanted guests. Cayenne may enjoy having cat friends to keep her company. She's known the kindness and compassion of a caregiver in her past, and that's what she deserves for her future.

We have added Cayenne to our Cactus Cat program so she can get extra attention from volunteers and have the safety net of fellow cactus feline friends. She may do well as a "working cat" or just a cat to support your housecats or join your growing cat family.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Cayenne and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Finch
description_html:
All of Finch's volunteer friends can't tell you enough how sweet natured, gentle, and a complete dream boat he is!


Not only is Finch handsome, but he is one of our easiest dogs at the shelter. He is a complete loose leash walker, taking time to sniff around and people watch. He seems to be pretty house trained, which is incredible for a dog that only gets out 20 minutes a day if that. In a yard Finch loves to lay around in the kiddie pool during this Texas heat or casually enjoy a game of fetch. He is a handsome young dog who walks like a dream on leash. Finch warms up pretty quickly to people and loves affection! He is also a sucker for treats.


If you are looking for a shepherd on the easier side, this guy should be #1 on your list!

name: Butternut
description_html: Butternut is very shy and scared but quickly warms up with patience and good treats. He’s very cuddly and playful after he is comfortable, and loves to swim. He goes from shy to having the zoomies and laying in your lap.

name: Poppi
description_html:
Poppi is a soft, delicate little lady who will capture your heart.

She loves having a confident dog friend near and will thrive best in a home with a friendly dog who appreciates a little friend like her.

The hair at Poppi's back end is still regrowing in from her former sad life conditions. She's on standard skin medications through the end of May. Her condition is expected to fully recover, it just takes a little time for hair to regrow. If Poppi is your heart dog, don't delay due to a temporary condition that's already on the mend. She needs you, and your dog friend at home.

name: Bruce
description_html:
Bruce shows us how much he loves and adores the people who care for him. He's very gentle. He asks only that you be sensitive with his heart and he'll reward you many times over.


He's smooth as silk on a leash.

He's crate trained, ideal for transitions and traveling to other's homes

Bruce will be neutered for adoption or while in foster care.

Are you ready to show a sweet dog all that life is supposed to be?

He's waiting to meet you..

name: Shakira
description_html: Taking after her namesake, Shakira is a pretty girl and her tail wags don’t lie! Still young, she has puppy curiosity about the outside world and plays well in our playgroup at the animal shelter- she was even paired with a doggy roommate! If you’re looking for a pup who is ready to explore what being a loving member of the household is like, Shakira would be happy to meet you!

name: Sage
description_html:
Sage came in with several other cats from a difficult situation. She is a classic "Cactus Cat", meaning she's still learning to trust people and she may always be on the independent side. She may make a great companion to a cat in the home since she enjoys the company of other felines and may relax more with cat friends to guide her. Sage prefers to be adored from a distance and engaged with through "play" and "snacks". We think this is the best way to get to know her and bond with her. If you're looking to add a touch of sass to your life, this girl might be the one for you!

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Sage and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Stormie Rain
description_html:
Her name says it all - she's the best rainy day, cozy up, cuddle up with the blankies companion - she's long on comforts, and has a very relaxed viewpoint of life that makes having her around a breeze.


Stormie Rain is looking forward to the best of the rest of life ahead of her. She's preparing well by staying in a foster home in cozy comforts and is always perfectly appointed for parties. Reach out on her link to connect with her foster.


Have a dog family member? We'll help set up a meet and greet at the shelter.

name: Beauty
description_html: Beauty takes a moment to warm up, but she's sooo sweet! She is very playful and affectionate once she gets to know you. She loves to romp around the play yard and chase toys, then she's happy to settle in with some pets. Beauty has lived with dogs in the past so may do well with a canine companion in the home with proper introductions. This special lady is ready for her next adventure in a home today!

name: Kangaskhan
description_html: Kangaskhan is a good natured, affectionate lady who had to be surrendered due to housing restrictions. She is crate trained and walks very well on leash! She knows several commands in Spanish: sit, stay, down, come and paw. Besides snuggles with people, she also loves squeaky toys and chew bones. This laid back lady is ready to be your special new family member today!

name: Lyric
description_html:
Pretty Lyric is a sweet young dog who strolls along easily on leash and appears housetrained. She is friendly, affectionate, mellow and a wonderful companion. Lyric does keep an eye out for pesky squirrels on her walks. 🐿️

She is dog friendly, and loves to romp around the playyard tossing around toys and jumping into the doggie pool. Lyric is a sweet, affectionate girl and a pleasure to spend time with.

Come meet this special girl!

name: Murphy
description_html:
Murphy is a gentle giant with a heart of gold. His favorite things in life are simple: comfy beds, cozy couches, sniffy walks, and spending time with his people. He's calm and easygoing around the house, but he'll happily show off his playful side when he's feeling excited. He's also done great riding elevators, making him a good companion for apartment living.

While Murphy can be a little cautious in new situations and around some unfamiliar sounds, he warms up quickly and is wonderfully sweet with new people. Once he feels comfortable, he's an affectionate cuddle bug who loves being close to his humans. Despite being a big boy, he's done great riding elevators and settling into apartment life, though he'd also love a backyard where he can sniff around, stretch his legs, and enjoy the sunshine.

Murphy walks beautifully on a leash, does great in the car, does well when left alone for a few hours, and is highly motivated by treats. During his time at the shelter, he also did well with the dogs he met, including a younger pup who looked a lot like him.

If you're looking for a loyal companion who enjoys leisurely walks, afternoon naps, and plenty of couch time, Murphy may be your perfect match. ❤️

name: Tessa
description_html:
Tessa was found as a stray by some kind members of the community, but they could not keep her long term. In the home, she was very affectionate and eager to stay close to her people. Tessa was a peaceful presence, completely housetrained, furniture friendly and ready to lounge with her friends and get lots of snuggles. She has shown curiosity toward dogs and calm children with slow introductions. Tessa is a playful girl and hasn't met a squeaky toy she didn't like. Ask staff to meet this girl today and prepare to fall in love!


Tessa is a very sweet, slightly shy dog. She’s very housetrained and pulls slightly when we start our walk. She seems curious about other dogs but isn’t reactive. She loves a long, sniffy walk and running around the play yard. Would probably do best in a quieter home and would love a yard, but can likely do an apartment. She has a very sweet demeanor and checks in for pets regularly

name: Lana
description_html:
Lana is a sweet and calm companion with a big heart for her people. She loves pets and is happy to lay nearby as you go about your routine. But get her in a playful mood, and she has a goofy side too! She never looks happier than when she’s chasing squirrels around the yard, and her soft ears perk up watching them in the trees - those pesky critters!


Lana is a smart girl who picks up commands quickly. She already knows sit and shake (paw), and is learning stay and come. She is house trained, respects the home, and does well with long periods alone - especially with a frozen Kong! She walks beautifully on the leash without tugging, but can get excited when she sees other dogs. 


While incredibly sweet and loyal with her known humans, Lana is still learning how to trust new people. She is curious about some house guests but mostly wants to observe from a safe distance. She has built a lot of confidence in a short time since coming into her foster home. A patient and loving adopter could help her blossom even more!

name: Layna
description_html: Layna is an itty bitty pocket pitty mix. She is a sweet mama who loves to sit with you and get pets and kisses. She is chill and gets along with dogs. She is easy to handle and to walk on leash. She enjoys sniffs in the play yard and friendly with men and women. She's equally independent and interested in you. She'll go off and sunbathe and then sit with you for quiet cuddles. She's super easy and laid back. Her petite size is a dream for apartments and homes a like. She'd be good with any age human.

name: Gorgonzola
description_html:
Gorgonzola is a charming pup who is just as delightful as his name suggests! He has a bright, infectious smile and cute ears that suggest he’s always ready for an adventure. He has a unique colored coat (similar to his namesake cheese) and striking eyes, making this guy truly one of a kind.  

Gorgonzola is the ultimate companion; he is incredibly cuddly and truly loves to stay close to his favorite humans. Whether you are relaxing at home or heading out for a stroll, he is a dream on a leash. While he enjoys a slightly playful romp, his true specialty is providing unconditional love and endless snuggles. Meet this sweet boy today and see if you’re his forever.

name: Truffle
description_html: Cherry & Truffle came in together and love each other very much so they must be adopted together! Cherry is very loyal and loving. She enjoys being close to her people without the need to be on top of them! Truffle will steal pets from you and soak up all your attention. They both love window watching. These girls are in need of some TLC today!

name: Cherry
description_html: Cherry & Truffle came in together and love each other very much so they must be adopted together! Cherry is very loyal and loving. She enjoys being close to her people without the need to be on top of them! Truffle will steal pets from you and soak up all your attention. They both love window watching. These girls are in need of some TLC today!

name: Lena
description_html:
Meet this sweet, gentle girl who's ready to charm everyone she meets! While she may need a little encouragement to hop into the car, once she's inside she's a wonderful passenger with great car manners. She especially enjoys looking out the window, keeping an eye out for the family she'll one day call her own.

She recently visited a local farmers market and quickly became a favorite with vendors and shoppers alike. Calm, patient, and incredibly polite, she happily accepted attention from everyone she met. Her favorite stops were the booths with fans blowing cool air her way! Although she made it clear which tasty treats she'd love to bring home, she never tried to steal anything and was a perfect lady throughout the outing.

On walks, she has nice leash manners and is easy to handle. She enjoys noticing other dogs and may gently pull to say hello, but she's simply curious and interested. She also ignored children running nearby, showing a calm and relaxed demeanor in a busy environment.

After a fun day out, she's just as happy to settle in at home. She enjoys chewing on dog toys, watching the world (and even dog videos!) with curiosity, and melting into the couch for belly rubs. She also loves sniffing around food areas, so she'll likely benefit from a little guidance on table manners.

If you're looking for a friendly, easygoing companion who enjoys adventures as much as cozy evenings at home, this lovely girl could be the perfect addition to your family.

name: Hugo
description_html: Hugo is a friendly, playful guy who loves to go on long walks with his favorite people. He's an absolute cuddler, too! This smart boy knows basic commands like "sit" & "stay". Hugo's favorite activities are splashing in water and going for car rides. He appreciates a calmer home environment and may do best in a home without small children.

name: Kilo
description_html:
With a big smile and a heart to match, Kilo is ready to capture yours! This handsome, tan-and-white pup is the ultimate cuddle machine. If there’s an open spot next to you on the couch, expect Kilo to fill it instantly. He loves affection, especially belly rubs! 

He’s not just a professional snuggler, though—he’s got the brains to back up the beauty. Kilo is a certified smarty-pants who already knows sit, shake, and down. He loves to show off his tricks for treats! He is also great on a leash and generally pretty easygoing. Ready for a loyal, intelligent, extra-cuddly best friend? Kilo is your guy.

name: Kai
description_html:
Kai is a sweet, sensitive girl who just needs a little time, patience, and kindness to show you her true self. When she first arrived in foster care, she was shy and unsure, but watching her blossom into a loving companion has been incredibly rewarding. 💕

Once Kai feels comfortable, she becomes your quiet little shadow - happily following her person around, relaxing nearby on the couch, and soaking up gentle pets and affection. She has a calm, peaceful presence and a soft personality that makes her a wonderful companion.

Kai is looking for a special adopter who understands that the best friendships aren't rushed - they're built one small moment of trust at a time. In return, she will reward your patience with loyalty, affection, and a whole lot of love.

If you're searching for a gentle companion who will remind you that the sweetest bonds are the ones we earn, Kai may be the perfect match for you. 🐾❤️

name: Chancho
description_html:
Chancho is the kind of dog who makes people slow down and enjoy the moment. He's one of the cuddliest dogs around and is happiest when he's close to his favorite people.


This handsome guy is housetrained, walks nicely on leash with only mild pulling, and enjoys leisurely sniffing adventures while checking in with his handler along the way. He's generally neutral around people and other dogs, though he may show a little curiosity when passing canine friends.
