More than anything, Chancho loves affection and is always ready to curl up for a cuddle.


Chancho can be a little sensitive about strangers reaching over the top of his head. If given the chance to approach at his own pace, his sweet, affectionate personality quickly shines through. Once he feels comfortable, he's an incredibly loving companion who wants nothing more than to be by your side.


If you're looking for a laid-back, medium-energy dog who enjoys peaceful walks, quiet companionship, and plenty of snuggles, Chancho could be the perfect match.

name: Azuki
description_html:
Meet this sweet young boy looking for his forever home!

He is an incredibly friendly, calm, and loving dog who truly enjoys being around people. He gets along well with other dogs, is not aggressive at all, and is very non-reactive — he rarely barks and handles new environments, noises, rain, and other dogs with confidence and ease.

He already knows some commands, such as sit, stay, wait, go, and lay down, and he is very food motivated, which makes continued training easy and rewarding. He rides beautifully in the car, sits calmly during trips, and enjoys being by your side wherever you are.

While he does not enjoy being confined to a kennel, he absolutely loves relaxing on the couch or curling up on a comfy dog bed. He is affectionate without being overwhelming — he loves cuddles and belly rubs, stays close to his people, and has a calm, comforting presence. He’s the kind of companion who simply enjoys being near you.

Healthy, vaccinated, neutered, and ready to start his next chapter, he is looking for a loving home where he can finally settle in and be part of the family.

name: Tyson
description_html:
Where spirit meets affection, you'll find Tyson waiting with his excellent home manners. Give him a spot by the window where he can dream of his next outdoor adventure. He can entertain himself and he's gentle with his toys. Outdoors he has a curious spirit for walks, hikes, and for his backyard squirrel patrols.

Don’t let the hint of grey on his snout fool you; he’s full of enthusiasm and ready for all of your activities. Above all, Tyson adores being with people and he’s easy to please. Pass the cheese board please..his favorite.

Tyson has shared his space with other dogs during times of his life.

If you have a resident dog, a meet and greet can be set up.

See his short video here. He'll be keeping an ear up waiting for you to come by to meet him.

Till then, much love!

name: Duke
description_html:
Duke is an outdoorsman at heart and would love to be your adventure buddy! Whether it's a hike through the woods, a neighborhood stroll, or a trip to your favorite river or swimming hole, this SUPER friendly, laid back guy is happiest exploring the world by your side. He absolutely loves the water and will happily cool off in our backyard pond whenever he gets the chance.


While Duke enjoys the great outdoors, he's also a wonderful house guest. He's calm, easy to walk on leash, and has been living peacefully in a foster home with a kitten, three adult cats, and two small breed dogs. He gets along great with other dogs and does well in playgroups, making him an excellent companion for a multi pet household.


Duke is a gentle, good natured sweetheart who has also enjoyed the company of children. He has an easygoing personality, kind manners, and a heart that's ready to find a family of his own. He takes a daily allergy medication to help manage some itchy skin, but otherwise he's in great health and ready for many more adventures.


If you're looking for a loyal companion who loves nature as much as he loves his people, Duke is ready for his next adventure with you!

name: Charlie
description_html:
Charlie is an excellent human and dog companion! He is handsome with an attentive, soulful gaze that will melt your heart instantly. Whether he is mingling with his four-legged friends in playgroup or strolling calmly through the neighborhood, Charlie is a dream on a leash and a true social butterfly. He could go home with a dog sibling after a meet & greet at the shelter.  

Charlie also shines when its time to cuddle and he lives for cozy moments and quiet companionship. If you are looking for a gentle soul to balance fun adventures with plenty of snuggles, Charlie is your guy!

name: Fern
description_html:
Meet Fern! If you're looking for a clever, affectionate companion who loves to learn, Fern is ready to steal your heart.

Fern is a house-trained, eager-to-please pup who catches on to training amazingly fast. She has a super fun energy and quickly settles in once she gets moving, softening up for endless pets and affection. Her brain is always working, making reward-based training a total breeze and a great way to bond with her.

She's also a dream on a leash, making stepping out for walks quick, simple, and enjoyable. Fern loves love, learns quickly, and is ready to bring plenty of joy and sweetness to her forever home.

Reach out today to set up a time to meet Fern!

name: Tira
description_html:
Tira (short for Tiramisu) is currently nursing 8 kittens born in late March. She is available for adoption after she is no longer nursing and/or when her kittens are adopted (as well as other requirements as part of AAC policy such as spay/neuter and microchipped).


Tira is really sweet, gentle, and very sincere. She will feed her kittens immediately after taking a few bites of her wet food and will finish her food once she is done nursing.


Tira is only 9-months old and was a community cat before I brought her inside.

name: Ava
description_html:
She's the cutest, always ready to strike a pose. She doesn't mind a little dress up.

Sweet Ava is calm, polite and a nice lady who remembers everyone she meets.

When you get to her level she'll be dishing out the kisses.

She's super house trained, quiet and excellent at home.

See her adorable self here

Fun things we've noticed - Ava picks her wildlife - she watches birds without intruding upon them but squirrels may get a little chase. And her fav toy choice is a good stuffy.

Ava has shared space with a couple of dog friends while at the shelter. She's had a low vision, low hearing BFF and prefers to have respectful co-existing friends like herself, who are nice and calm.

She can't wait to meet you!

name: Akira
description_html:
Akira is a loving 1 year old girl who is ready to find her forever home.

Being a little over 1 years old - she’s still figuring out a lot but she is incredibly intelligent, intuitive, and a very good listener. She would be best suited for a medium active household with access to a yard — she loves being in her foster parents yard.


She has been thriving each day out of the shelter. She’s walks nicely on lease, loves to sniff, and loves meeting new people and dogs.


She loves to play with her foster brother who has a similar play style as her but coexists well with her foster sister who doesn’t like to play as much. Girls girl. She is also very talented at disengaging with her siblings and taking breaks to re-regulate when she needs to. Her foster parents think she could be a single dog household or come to a house with siblings! She has LOVED playing and engaging with her foster siblings which helps entertain her, we think!


Akira is a big cuddle bug & will nicely come sit and paw/pet you in exchange for so love and pets.


Akira is a special girl and knows sit, settle, off, and lay down. She sits nicely as she’s being fed and loves ripping the stuffing out of all her toys & loves to thrash. A backyard with a fence would also be best suited for her; she loves to go outside and watch nature and the squirrels.


To follow along and get more insight into Akira’s day to day at her foster house - check out @leaps.n.chomps_fosterhouse !! That’s her foster parents Instagram page where they are most active and responsive!

name: Zoom
description_html:
Zoom is exactly what her name suggests: a happy, social puppy who is ready to zoom straight into someone’s life.She is sweet, playful, outgoing, and extremely people-oriented. At intake, she wanted to greet everyone she passed and immediately rolled into belly-rub mode for staff.


Zoom is also a little social butterfly with other dogs. During her playgroup evaluation, she entered the yard on her own and immediately joined in soft puppy play. Staff described her as very stable, and she happily played for the entire session before being paired with a doggy roommate.


Like any young puppy, Zoom is still learning the finer points of grown-up dog life. She can be jumpy and enthusiastic, has limited leash skills, and sometimes wants to rush over to greet every dog she sees. The good news is that staff describe her as eager to please, eager for attention, and full of potential to learn.


If you’re looking for a friendly, playful youngster who loves people, loves dogs, and is ready to learn everything by your side, Zoom might be your girl. Come meet her today!

name: Harry
description_html:
If you’re not a private person, then Harry was made for you! He will lovingly be all in your business. 😊

Harry arrived at AAS with a left-sided head tilt, a URI, and a wobbly walk. He moved into foster care and was treated for a possible middle/inner ear infection with antibiotics for six weeks. The wobbliness and URI resolved, and the head tilt is much better. He will likely be prone to external ear infections, so to help prevent these, ear cleaning is recommended once or twice a week (we’ll give you some epi-otic to get you started).

Harry is great with other cats, and that’s an understatement! He would be happiest having a cat buddy in his new home. He is friendly, affectionate (he’ll sometimes give luv nips), loving, social, and an all-around wonderful companion!

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Harry and ALL Desperate Housecats!

name: Annie
description_html:
Miss Annie presented to the shelter as a very sweet but scared lady who had been found on her own, at less than 40lbs, in very rough condition, overbred, under loved, and in need of an outstretched hand and lots of polishing work. See a short video of her early days of shelter kennel life.


Annie was welcomed to a foster home to share life experiences with a full family of adults, kids, dogs and cats. Annie's so happy to fit in and be counted as part of a family. Our wish for her, is to find her forever family, be it big or small, a safe and stable home, where she'll be cherished for all her time yet to come, to make up for years of lost opportunity. She must never return to a life of neglect.


Her advocacy group Classic Canines paired with Annie's fosters to provide for all of Annie's wellness care needs while she's been in her foster home. Annie is a healthy lady today who carries only a diminished hearing from her past. See her makeover here


Will you be the one to carry the rest of Annie's story forward?

Reach out on her link to connect with her foster.

name: Fiesta
description_html:
Fiesta is a sweet, affectionate boy who's ready to trade shelter life for a loving home. Like many dogs who have spent time in the shelter, he's developed some stress-related habits—such as jumping during the first few minutes of a walk—but these behaviors weren't present when he first arrived and are expected to improve once he's in a calmer home environment.


With a few treats and a little patience, Fiesta quickly settles into an easy, loose-leash walk. He loves sniffing and exploring, checks in often with his person, and is happiest when he's spending quality time together. In the play yard, he'll happily romp around with toys before coming back for pets, treats, and affection. In the Real Life Room, he's all about relaxing and soaking up attention.


Fiesta is housetrained, treat-motivated, and medium energy. He'd thrive with an adopter who can provide a little guidance during exciting moments and plenty of love, playtime, and companionship. If you're looking for a fun, loyal dog who truly enjoys being with his people, Fiesta is ready to celebrate life with you!

name: Bonnie
description_html: Want a playful, loving companion in your life? Look no further than Bonnie! She loves to cuddle with people and has shared her space peacefully with resident cats in her previous home. Take her on walks and she happily trots beside you to enjoy the scenery. Bonnie is extremely affectionate and will lounge with you throughout the day or evening. This girl has so much love to give, and she's ready to open her heart to a new home today!

name: Rhonda
description_html:
Rhonda is an easygoing sweetheart. She is loving, cheerful, and house-trained. She does great with other dogs and loves to cuddle up on the couch. She also loves treats and is easy to train.

Rhonda makes friends with everyone she meets and is a confident gal. Everywhere we go, people tell us how sweet she is and that she looks just like Scooby Doo!

name: Charlotte
description_html:
Charlotte is a sweet, loving pup who gives her whole heart to the people she meets. It doesn’t take long for her to decide you’re her new best friend—she’s that kind of dog.

She’s incredibly social and does great with both humans and other dogs, making her an easy addition to many homes. Whether she’s meeting new friends or hanging out with her people, Charlotte is always happy to be part of the moment.

One of her favorite things? Car rides! She’s a calm and easy passenger who will happily curl up in the back seat and enjoy a peaceful nap while you drive.

Charlotte is also a big fan of treats and takes them ever so gently—just another sign of her sweet and easygoing nature.

If you’re looking for a loyal companion who’s affectionate, friendly, and ready to love you from day one, Charlotte might just be your perfect match. .

name: Lil Luna
description_html:
Hi there! I’m Lil Luna — a pocket-sized bundle of love with a heart way bigger than my paws. 🌙✨

I may be little, but my personality is larger than life! I’m sweet, playful, and always ready to make you smile with my goofy antics and happy wiggles. Whether I’m zooming around the yard, snuggling up beside you, or giving you my big soulful eyes, I know how to make every moment brighter.

I can be a little shy when meeting new people, but give me a little patience and kindness, and I’ll quickly become your loyal shadow and best friend. Once I trust you, I’m all about cuddles, kisses, and soaking up every bit of love I can get.

I dream of a forever home where I can feel safe, cherished, and part of the family. In return, I promise endless affection, laughter, and unconditional love.

Could you be the happily-ever-after my little heart has been waiting for? 🐾💕

name: Charlie
description_html:
Charlie is a darling handsome grand boy. Big at heart, with an easy going manner who brings a sense of calm to his foster home.

Charlie arrived to the shelter as an unknown dog, with a large knot on his front left leg that deserved a closer look. It was steadily growing followed a progression typically seen in bone cancer. In his foster home he's been paired with medical support by Classic Canines and after further assessment, all DVM's agreed that leg should be removed. Charlie is healthy and quite fit and will thrive as a tripod and not be in pain and with the threat of an untimely bone break averted.


See his before short video here.

Check back soon for an after video. His surgery is 7/6/2026.


He's very housetrained, nice to walk on a leash but whether he's on 3 legs or 4 legs, lizard and squirrel chases are going to always be fun for him. He'll be ready to play fetch again soon. He prefers to not have to eat alone and loves having a view to the outside world and loves companionship. He was mascot to a volunteer enrichment exercise and was said to be like a therapy dog for all. He's very social and loves everyone equally.


Charlie is advocated for by his friends at ClassicCaninesATX which means his adopters get extra support for supplies and care with his adoption and of course, all medical records..

name: Tangerine
description_html:
Meet Tangerine! 🐾

This girl is the whole package,sweet, snuggly, and endlessly fun. She’s crate and house trained, walks nicely on a leash, and gets along wonderfully with other dogs. She only barks when the pack does, loves playing with toys, and turns into a total goofball the second the hose comes out! 💦

She’s a quick learner too, knows sit, come, and lay down, and is working on paw. The only thing she asks for is a home without cats or small critters (chickens are not her friends 🐔).

Cuddly, playful, and ready to steal your heart, she just needs someone to give her a chance! 💕

Just a heads up: We’re heading out of town after the July 17th and can’t keep fostering her past then, so we’re hoping to find her next spot very soon! We’d love to at least find her a foster to keep her momentum going strong, would mean the world!

I’m flexible and happy to meet up if interested in meeting her!

name: Zeb
description_html:
Meet Zeb!


Zeb is a handsome young pup with a big heart and an even bigger love for fun. At just over a year old, this sweet and playful boy enjoys spending time outdoors, playing fetch, going for walks, and chewing on his favorite bones. He already knows commands like sit and stay, walks nicely on leash, and is friendly with both familiar people and new faces.


Zeb has lived successfully with another dog and enjoys canine companionship, making him a great candidate for a home with a friendly dog. He is crate trained, accustomed to spending time alone in a crate, and is housetrained when given regular opportunities to go outside.


His previous family describes him as sweet and playful. Zeb loves being part of the action and can get excited during playtime. He does well with older children!


Zeb is looking for a family that will appreciate his affectionate nature, playful spirit, and loyal personality. With continued guidance and plenty of exercise, this wonderful boy has all the ingredients to become an amazing lifelong companion.


If you're searching for a fun-loving best friend who enjoys adventures, playtime, and being close to his people, Zeb may be the perfect match for you!

name: Ace
description_html: Meet Ace! He’s the life of the party! This goofy guy is kennel trained, potty trained, dog-friendly, and always ready to make you laugh before curling up for cuddles. He’s got the personality, the charm, and the heart to be everyone’s favorite sidekick.

name: Sunshine
description_html: Sunshine is such a sweet girl! She adores playtime and can happily self-entertain with squeaky toys; the way she rolls around with her toys is adorable and will fill your home with smiles and joy. Sunshine also loves water and splashing around in the kiddie pool. She is also very easy to walk on a leash! She is dog-social and could fit into many different lifestyles; meet Sunshine and see if she is your ray of light!

name: Mazda
description_html:
Meet Mazda, a cute three-year-old who has a soft spot for belly rubs and cuddles. Volunteers and Staff consistently say that Mazda is so sweet. We know that she will win your heart over, too!

Mazda would love to go on hikes or take long walks. Mazda likes playing fetch with a toy and also likes her downtime with human affection and pets.

Adopting a pup like Mazda offers the opportunity to skip the demanding puppy phase while still having a young, trainable companion ready to bond and explore life with you. Mazda is ready to start her new leash on life with her forever family and hopes that you come do a meet and greet today!

name: Palomo
description_html: Palomo is a stunning husky/shepherd mix with a smile that will melt your heart! True to his name, this handsome boy is as sweet and gentle as a dove. Palomo is the perfect blend of playfulness and affection; he loves a good romp around the yard just as much as he loves leaning in for full-body cuddles. With his striking ears, expressive eyes, and a tail that never stops wagging, he radiates pure joy. If you’re looking for a loyal, fun-loving companion to brighten your days and join you on every adventure, Palomo is ready to be your forever best friend!

name: Howard Butts
description_html:
Meet Howard E Butts.  Howard was found roaming around the local Dollar Tree.  Unfortunately, Howard's bank account was empty, but he found a nice lady that lured him to the car with cold sausages. As his name implies, he is a true Texan, and a true lover of ALL groceries. 


Howard has been enjoying time with his foster brothers Jonah (a human) and George Bailey (a dog that thinks he’s human.)  He loves walks in the hood, and a couch cuddle right after.  He knows what “go potty,” “sit,” “bedtime,” “dinner,” and “treat,” all mean… and he doesn’t miss a meal. 


Howard loves people, and dogs.  He loves sharing water and toys, but prefers dinner alone.  He is fast, but is easily recalled. Howard loves getting a little alone time, sleeping in his crate at night. His foster mom and dad love snuggling him, and would love to see him go to a home where he gets outdoor time, snuggles, and maybe has a sibling or two, though he also would be cool with alone time.

name: Emmylou
description_html: It may take Emmylou a little while for her to warm up but when she does she welcomes pets and will be your best buddy. She is great on leash, a gentle treat taker and she is very house trained. She does have a playful side but you may not see that right away. Anyone considering Emmylou should be patient and go at her pace.

name: Princess
description_html:
Princess is a sweet girl ready to rule your heart! She deserves the royal treatment (but is actually pretty low-maintenance), which to her means plenty of cuddles and affection. She has the most radiant, happy smile and a beautiful coat.

Princess strikes the perfect balance of being easygoing around the house while still showing off a charming, playful side. She is highly treat-motivated and already knows how to "sit" perfectly. This smart pup is eager to learn even more tricks in exchange for her favorite snacks. Ready to add some charm to your life? Princess is the one!

name: Cinnamon
description_html: Cinnamon was abandoned at a rescue and then brought to us for care. She was shy at first, but now she's showing us her active, playful side and telling us she's done with kennel life! This girl is ready to do zoomies around a home. Cinnamon loves Churu, so that may be the best way to make introductions. She enjoys pets and once she's in a calm home setting, we think that's when she will truly blossom! So add some spice to your life and adopt Cinnamon today!

name: Ingrid
description_html:
Ingrid & Dora are sisters who enjoy each other's company and would like to get adopted together! These girls are happy, wiggly, playful and affectionate. They love quality time with people, long walks or romping around the yard, and playing fetch. Ingrid & Dora are a fun duo that would add silly girl entertainment to your days while bringing calm snuggles to your evenings. Don't miss out on double the love and appreciation with this pair.


Ingrid is so sweet and SO looking forward to having a family of her own. She loves sniffy walks out in the grass and would love to have family that likes to play with her and have her cuddling close. She's sweet as pie and so ready to go home. She may be able to go home without her sister Dora, they love each other but show promise being apart.

name: Dora
description_html:
Ingrid & Dora are sisters who enjoy each other's company and would like to get adopted together! These girls are happy, wiggly, playful and affectionate. They love quality time with people, long walks or romping around the yard, and playing fetch. Ingrid & Dora are a fun duo that would add silly girl entertainment to your days while bringing calm snuggles to your evenings. Don't miss out on double the love and appreciation with this pair.


Dora is soooo cuddly and sweet. She likes treats and she loves to come close for cuddles and belly scratches. She likes toys but she's most interested in connection with her people. She's a sweet, lovely little dog.

name: Toby
description_html: Toby is a graduate of our Enduring Service program! To learn more about this program, read about it on our website. According to his Enduring Service program handlers Toby is a big goofy boy and plays well with other dogs. He is crate trained and walks well with a harness. Easy to bath and knows commands like sit, down and stay. Toby is a pup who is still working on jumping to greet you, but he's enthusiastic about his people! He loves toys and chews and can play fetch with anything. Toby can't wait to meet his forever family!

name: Layla
description_html:
Layla was in foster care where we learned so much about her! She's extremely affectionate and loves to cuddle, putting her head on your chest or thigh whenever she can. If allowed, she'll also give kisses. While she may be shy around new people, it only takes her 30 minutes or so to come out of her shell. Layla enjoys exploring her surroundings with her companions and stays close by your side. She would thrive in a home that offers her the attention she craves and deserves!


"She is such a dream to walk. You have to look out for the occasional squirrel, which she will try to chase if you get too close, otherwise she is a loose leash walker who checks in often. I started teaching her "sit" and she is eager to learn it and has gotten it on her own already a couple of times. She was a dream in the car. She was not fearful of the car ride and just laid down in the backseat. I did introduce her to my cat through a fenced off area and she seemed to lunge at the cat similarly to how she was lunging to chase a squirrel on her walk."

name: Milo
description_html:
Howdy folks!

I'm Milo and I have a lot of people friends here who adore me. They say I smile a lot and I'm loads of fun and they love my puppyish looks and how I like just hanging out people as they chat. I love making new friends and can't wait to meet you too.


Here's some highlights of my resume;

  • I'm very house trained
  • I love free play time in a yard, hikes and other activities
  • I've been crated at the shelter - this is a good stay-home-alone plan for me
  • I'll be happy to keep your spaces clear of squirrels and critters!


See you soon, Your New Friend Milo

name: Maui
description_html: Maui is a graduate of our Enduring Service program! To learn more about this program, read about it on our website. According to his Enduring Service program handlers Maui is a fun-loving dog that loves playing soccer and chasing a tennis ball around a yard. Has great leash manners but does enjoy being in the A/C more. He is kennel and potty trained. Very people friendly and sweet. He is very loyal and would make a great addition to any family.

name: Zelda
description_html:
I'm Zelda!


My owner of 4 years brought me to the shelter due to their medical issues that made it harder for her to take care of me.


I can be a tad shy but once I warm up I love to snuggle!


Want a running or hiking buddy? You are looking at her!


I know lots of tricks! Stay, down, come, paw, roll over, back up, give kisses - you name it and I will probably know it or can figure out how to do it!


Come meet me today!

name: Benny
description_html:
Benny is such a fun, spunky guy! He likes other dogs, loves to play with toys, and is super smart. In fact, one volunteer was just about able to teach him to sit in about 3 minutes! (We say "just about able" because it takes routine practice, but Benny definitely got the idea and we know he'd learn even more tricks very quickly because he's a super smart cookie and is treat motivated!)


Benny is hoping for an adopter who loves to explore and adventure and will bring him along for the fun. He'd also be a great wingman if you need one - Benny loves everyone he meets!


Benny is a young pup who is so endearing. Still learning so much about the world. Absolutely hilarious and so playful around water. Seeks out pets and attention. Pretty easy on leash, just an all around wonderful dog!


Email his friends at orangedotcrew@gmail.com for more info!

name: Hobbes
description_html: Hobbes is perfect with a capital P. He doesn’t react to dogs, birds, or squirrels on walks. He walks alongside you with a loose leash. He LOVES cuddles and pets more than anything else. Hobbes would probably live happily in an apartment; he's quiet and small-sized, and really just wants to snuggle with people. Hobbes is a social butterfly waiting for his new friends to invite him to happy hour!

name: Kash
description_html: Kash is an easy boy for walks and he loves hanging out with people! This friendly guy enjoys playing with toys and will gladly come up to you for pets and reassurance. He's more than ready to get attention daily in a foster or adoptive home today!

name: Gus
description_html:
Meet Gus — a 12/10 good boy who’s ready to bring joy, laughs, and lots of love into his forever home!

Gus is incredibly friendly with both people and other dogs. He’s playful and fun, but also thoughtful—he’s great at adjusting his energy to match his canine buddies, whether they’re ready to romp or just hang out.

He’s still a young guy at heart and gets excited to say hello, so he’s working on keeping all four paws on the ground. Because of that enthusiasm, he may do best with older kids while he continues learning his manners.

Gus loves getting out for a nice long walk (about a mile is his sweet spot), and he’s a dream on leash with his Easy Walk harness. When the day winds down, he’s just as happy curling up next to you on the couch for some quality cuddle time.

He’s a total star at home too—crate trained, no potty accidents, and not destructive. He understands “no,” settles in easily, and even handles mealtime and bedtime in his crate without a fuss. His only quirk? He sometimes likes to start the day a little early—but he makes up for it with enthusiasm and tail wags!

Bonus: Gus loves ice cubes—they’re his favorite treat.

Gus would thrive in a home with another playful dog and an active family who can give him a couple of good walks each day. If you’re looking for a sweet, fun-loving companion who’s equal parts adventure buddy and cuddle bug, Gus might just be your perfect match.

name: Woody
description_html:
Woody is the sweetest dog. He's very gentle and careful, even when playing, and is great with kids of all ages. He loves tug of war and will politely bring a toy so you can play. Or he drops one so you can throw it for him! He is house trained and will wait by the door to go outside or make a little squeak to remind you it's time to go. Woody rarely barks and never at other dogs but is loud when you need him. Woody came to us severely underweight but after a little time with his foster he's fully healthy! He would be a lovable addition to any home, with or without children or pets.


Email me if you have any questions: austfosts@gmail.com

name: Schneider
description_html:
Hey guys, Schneider here!


Listen, I came from a hoarding situation so I might not exactly know how things work with humans, but I've been putting in THE WORK these last few months so I can find a home where someone will let me hang out, follow them around, and learn the ropes of what a house should be.


My leash skills are continuing to improve and I rarely pull. I love to sniff every bush I pass. I'm as quiet as a mouse, you won't hear a peep from me! The first time I was ever touched by a human was a little scary, but I've slowly been working on getting comfortable with it with my shelter friends!


I had a few furry dog friends where I came from, and I've enjoyed seeing them from time to time while at the shelter so if you bring your pup I'd be down to meet them to see if they could be my new friend!


I'm looking for a patient, understanding home that will celebrate my small victories and give me the time I needs to blossom. Watching me grow and come out of my shell will be a truly rewarding experience.

name: Sushi
description_html: Sushi is shy to open up, but once she does, she's a lovebug! She's a great mix of cuddler and independent. For some parts of the day she likes to hide/do her own thing, but generally when I'm home, she's interactive. She's one of my favorite fosters ever!!! A great kitty. LOVES to eat. Likes to play too!

name: Evan
description_html:
Meet Evan 💙

Evan is a gentle, sweet boy who has made wonderful progress building his confidence during his time at the shelter. Watching him come out of his shell has been such a joy—he truly wants to connect and be close to his people.

This handsome pup is a dream on leash, walking calmly by your side without pulling. He’s also very treat-motivated and already knows how to sit, which makes continuing his training both easy and fun.

Evan can still be a little sensitive to touch at first, but he’s trying so hard—leaning in, learning to trust, and showing more comfort every day. It’s clear he wants affection and is figuring out how to enjoy it at his own pace. He’s done great meeting new people, including a recent introduction to a new volunteer, where he showed just how far he’s come.

With a little patience and a lot of love, Evan is going to blossom into an incredibly loyal and affectionate companion. If you’re looking for a kind-hearted dog to grow with, Evan is ready to meet you.

name: Spartan
description_html:
Spartan is a shy, sensitive soul who becomes something completely different once he decides you are his person. Volunteers describe him as sweet, affectionate, easy to walk, and absolutely endearing. One put it perfectly: Spartan can seem reserved at first, but once he knows you, “he melts when he sees you.”


Spartan has become a favorite walking companion for volunteers. He has repeatedly shown lovely loose-leash manners around campus and tends to move at a slow, thoughtful pace while he takes in the world. He knows sit and come, checks in with his handler, and is easily redirected with treats if nervousness gets the better of him. Volunteers have also reported that he seems house-trained and enjoys hanging out in the shelter’s Real Life Room.


He has some great dog skills, too. Spartan has participated in multiple shelter playgroups, offering soft greetings, tolerating some fairly pushy canine behavior, exploring comfortably alongside other dogs, and occasionally joining in chase play. More recently, he entered playgroup on his own, greeted his friends nicely, peacefully coexisted, and spent part of the session relaxing in the shade with his human. He lives with a doggy roommate here at the shelter and has great potential to live in a many-dog household—ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet and greet with your resident dog(s)!


What Spartan needs most is a family willing to let friendship happen on his timetable. Unfamiliar people can make him nervous, particularly when they approach quickly or enter his space. Shelter volunteers have seen the other side of that story repeatedly: with a little patience, he warms up into an affectionate dog who wants to stay close to the people he trusts.


Spartan doesn’t need to be the life of the party. He needs people who appreciate a dog whose love is earned—and therefore feels extra special when you get it. Give him calm introductions, good walks, some treats, and enough time to decide you’re a friend, and you may get to watch this shy boy completely melt.

name: Linda Lou
description_html:
Meet Linda Lou 💕🐾

Well hello there, darling — I’m Linda Lou, and yes, I’m every bit as charming as my name sounds.

I’m a sweet girl with a gentle heart and a loving soul. I am very shy when it comes to meeting new people but am working on my bravery. My favorite things in life are soft beds, kind humans, tasty treats, and being told I’m pretty (which I will gladly accept at any hour of the day). I’ve got a calm, affectionate nature.

I’m the kind of dog who wants to be part of your everyday life. Morning coffee companion? That’s me. Couch cuddle supervisor? Absolutely. Loyal best friend who listens without judgment? I was born for it.

I may take a little time to settle into new situations, but once I know I’m safe and loved, my personality blossoms beautifully. Underneath it all is a dog who simply wants connection, comfort, and someone to love forever.

Here’s what you should know about me:

  • I give world-class cuddle energy
  • I have a heart as soft as my puppy-dog eyes
  • I’m happiest just being near my people
  • I will absolutely become your little shadow

I’ve been dreaming about a forever home where I can finally exhale, feel safe, and spend my days loving the humans lucky enough to choose me.

If you’re looking for a loyal companion with sweetness, grace, and just a sprinkle of sass, I think we should meet.

Love,

Linda Lou 🐶💗

name: Lulabelle
description_html:
Meet Lulabelle — a gentle, growing soul who is just beginning to discover the world around her. Coming from a hoarding situation, everything is still new to her, and she’s learning step by step what it means to feel safe and cared for.

Lulabelle may not fully understand affection just yet, but she’s making steady, heartwarming progress. She’s started to approach familiar people for polite sniffs and will happily accept a few treats, showing her curiosity and quiet bravery. Each day, she’s building confidence and learning to trust a little more.

Lulabelle is dog friendly and would love a friend to show her the ropes. Her doggie roommate at the shelter has been showing her that humans aren't so scary and she's slowly starting to want more attention from people! Lulabelle is very sweet with a little bit of playful.

Lulabelle is looking for a patient, understanding home that will celebrate her small victories and give her the time she needs to blossom. Watching her grow and come out of her shell will be a truly rewarding experience.

name: Bluebelle
description_html:
Meet Bluebelle — a gentle, growing soul who is just beginning to discover the world around her. Coming from a hoarding situation, everything is still new to her, and she’s learning step by step what it means to feel safe and cared for.

Bluebelle may not fully understand affection just yet, but she’s making steady, heartwarming progress. She’s started to approach familiar people for polite sniffs and will happily accept a few treats, showing her curiosity and quiet bravery. Each day, she’s building confidence and learning to trust a little more.

Bluebelle is dog friendly, playful, and would love a friend to show her the ropes!

Bluebelle is looking for a patient, understanding home that will celebrate her small victories and give her the time she needs to blossom. Watching her grow and come out of her shell will be a truly rewarding experience.

name: Red
description_html: Red is very active but can also relax on the couch. She loves sniffing and exploring. Red is smart, cuddly and sweet. She would benefit from being with an owner who’s patient, experienced with dogs and can get professional training for her moments of reactivity towards some people and some dogs. She loves car rides. She is afraid of children so she needs some work with getting her to feel comfortable with children and kids.

name: Robin
description_html:
Robin spent just three weeks in foster—and it changed everything 💕

Away from the shelter, this gentle, soulful boy began to relax, trust, and let his personality shine. His foster watched him transform into an affectionate, goofy companion who loves sunshine, morning walks, bird and butterfly watching, a good chew, and simply being close to his people. Robin doesn’t need constant entertainment—he just wants to be part of your day.

Robin is crate trained, potty trained, and settled beautifully into home life. He thrives with consistency, patience, and positive reinforcement. Like many sensitive dogs, he may take a little time to feel comfortable in new places or with new people, but every day in foster he grew more confident, playful, and relaxed. Watching Robin blossom is one of the most rewarding parts of knowing him.

Robin would do best as the only pet in a calm home where he can continue building confidence. If you’re looking for an instant party animal, Robin probably isn’t your guy. But if your heart melts watching a dog slowly realize he’s safe—if you believe the best friendships are earned—you’ll find an incredibly loyal companion in Robin.

name: Angel
description_html:
Brawn AND brains? Yes, please. 💙

This sweet girl is the total package—affectionate, smart, and full of personality. She lives for love and will happily trade treats for cuddles any day. Expect lots of kisses, snuggles, and her signature wiggle butt when she’s showing off her skills!

✔️ Knows: sit, down, stop, come, paw

✔️ Fully potty trained

✔️ Crate trained (just prefers not to be left too long)

✔️ Super people-focused and eager to please

She gets the cutest little wrinkles when she’s waiting for praise—because attention is her favorite reward.

On leash, she’s a strong girl and can pull, so she’ll benefit from some continued training—but she’s smart and motivated, so she’s a great candidate to learn quickly.

If you’re looking for a loyal, loving, and fun companion who wants to be your shadow and your snuggle buddy, she’s your girl.

Come meet her—you’ll fall in love fast. 🐾💙

name: Felicia
description_html:
Felicia has been welcomed to a foster home that she shares with her caregivers, a dog and a cat. She's very polite to cats, both indoors and outdoors, and her current dog friend is a very cute, small older dog friend. She would probably enjoy a friendly, polite dog she can snuggle and play with.


Where people are, you'll find Felicia quietly nearby, just in case there's a call out for a snuggle, she'll be right there. Felicia also seems child friendly.


Her personality is gentle, sweet and easy.

She walks nicely on a leash and rides well in a car.

She's house trained and doggie door trained.

She's shown herself to be well rounded.


Felicia is healthy and comes with a clean bill of health from the shelter and her advocates at ClassicCaninesATX.


A common question - why is this dog in a shelter system?

Felicia was part of a larger dog crew that lost a longtime home and came to the shelter for safety. Life was not easy for their dog crew. Offering a bridge home by adopting a mature dog from the shelter system is a rewarding experience, for both you and the dog. One that you'll always remember.

name: Ruffles
description_html: Warning! This dog may appear shorter and cuter in person! She has a lot of spunk, may even belly flop into any amount of water outside. This retired mama acts very ladylike in home. She settles her barking quick once knowing you. She loves snuggles, diving headfirst into your chest. Once you show her love, so will she in return. Loves toys, has shown no mouthing on furniture or structures in home, except 2 socks… loves squeaky toys. Will seek being close to you in a storm. Prefers women.

name: Lila
description_html: Lila is a bouncy lady who loves snuggles. She enjoys treats and will sit calmly by your side after she has gotten her wiggles out. Lila loves playing fetch and would do well having a yard for exercise or a plan for walks on leash. She's an excellent walking companion, too! Lila is housetrained and knows to "sit" for treats. This smart girl is just beginning her journey and is looking for a loving adopter to join her!

name: Kitty
description_html:
Kitty is the kind of dog who turns heads the moment you meet her. Her tall, perky ears stand straight up like little exclamation points, always ready to catch the sound of a friendly voice or the rustle of something interesting. She has a gentle, sweet demeanor that makes you feel instantly at ease, and you can tell there’s so much personality just waiting to blossom once she finds her person.

She carries a large scar along her back, a quiet reminder that her start in life wasn’t easy. Kitty can’t tell us what she’s been through, but what’s remarkable is how she refuses to let her past dim her view of people. She greets the world with hope, softness, and a willingness to trust again.

On walks, Kitty begins with enthusiasm, then settles into a slower pace where she can take in the world—sniffing the breeze, watching the scenery, and enjoying the simple pleasure of being outside with someone she likes. Her favorite spot on campus is the Real Life Room, where she melts into snuggles and shows us exactly what she’s dreaming of: a home of her own.

Kitty is a world-class cuddler. She loves chin scratches, gives the sweetest hugs, and has mastered the art of climbing onto a chair just to be closer to you for more affection. She’s tender, observant, and endlessly loving.

Kitty is ready for someone who sees her not for the scar on her back, but for the bright, beautiful future she’s eager to share. If you’re looking for a loyal companion with a gentle soul and a heart full of love, Kitty is waiting to meet you.

name: Cricket
description_html: Cricket is a confident, independent dog looking for someone to take him on adventures! He's easygoing, walks really nicely on his leash, and knows sit and will do it very patiently for a treat. He's a really smart guy that likes the company of other dogs, enjoys pets, and while he may try to sit in your lap, he's not going to be glued to you. Nope - this boy isn't a stage five clinger at all. He's easy peasy, playful, and curious (but watch out, squirrels!). Cricket really is the whole package and anyone would be lucky to scoop up this uniquely handsome dude.

name: Elizabeth
description_html:
Meet Elizabeth — a gentle, growing soul who is just beginning to discover the world around her. Coming from a hoarding situation, everything is still new to her, and she’s learning step by step what it means to feel safe and cared for.

Elizabeth may not fully understand affection just yet, but she’s making steady, heartwarming progress. She’s started to approach familiar people for polite sniffs and will happily accept a few treats, showing her curiosity and quiet bravery. Each day, she’s building confidence and learning to trust a little more.

Elizabeth would love to meet your dog to see if they are a good match! She lived with multiple dogs previously.

Elizabeth is looking for a patient, understanding home that will celebrate her small victories and give her the time she needs to blossom. Watching her grow and come out of her shell will be a truly rewarding experience.

name: Fiona
description_html:
Meet Fiona — a scared, fiery, growing soul who is just beginning to discover the world around her. Coming from a hoarding situation, everything is still new to her, and she’s learning step by step what it means to feel safe and cared for.

Fiona may not fully understand affection just yet, but she’s starting to warm up to the idea. She plays hard to get, but she army crawled towards a volunteer friend recently to get closer, and we call that success around here. She’s started to approach familiar people for polite sniffs, showing her curiosity and quiet bravery. Each day, she’s building confidence and learning to trust a little more.

Fiona is dog friendly and would love a friend to show her the ropes. If you are looking for a sassy, hilarious, fun girl that just needs someone to show her the world isn't scary, she may be the dog for you!

Fiona is looking for a patient, understanding home that will celebrate her small victories and give her the time she needs to blossom. Watching her grow and come out of her shell will be a truly rewarding experience.


Hi, volunteer friend here - this girl has some things to learn but she has a fantastic personality behind that fear. She cracks me up, she drives me crazy, and you will love almost every second of it.

name: Rosie
description_html:
Rosie is a very sweet girl. She’s great with other dogs, calm mannered and a couch potato! She was found with her (presumed) sister, Daisy, and we would prefer they be adopted together as they are quite attached.


She is house and crate trained. She can be a bit anxious on a leash at first but once she trusts you it’s easy for her to just walk next to you. Overall just a great, sweet dog. Please give her a chance to show you!

name: Daisy
description_html:
Daisy is a super sweet. She does well with other dogs and loves to spend her day relaxing while every once in a while playing with the occasional toy. She was found with her (presumed) sister, Rosie, and we would prefer they be adopted together as they are quite attached.


She is house and crate trained. She can be a little anxious on a leash at first, but once she trusts you she will follow you anywhere. Overall just a great, sweet dog. Please give her a chance to show you!

name: Koso
description_html: Looking for a sweet, social boy who loves dogs, humans, and healthy snacks? Meet Koso! 🥕🫐 This smart pup is a rapid-fire learner—he's already mastered stairs, car rides, and mid-air treat catching! He spends his days wrestling with his senior Husky foster brother and snoring softly by the home office desk. He’s currently working hard on his leash manners (the squirrels are just very distracting!), but he’s making progress every day. Reach out to find your new best friend! 🐾

name: Creed
description_html:
Meet Creed!


Creed is a smart, affectionate, and energetic dog who has been a deeply loved member of his family for the past five years. Described by his owner as “one of the best dogs I have ever owned,” Creed is a loyal companion who thrives on human connection and enjoys being part of family life.


This handsome boy loves people of all ages, including children, and is always happy to make new friends. He’s friendly with unfamiliar people both on walks and at home, and his sweet, loving personality shines through once he’s around his people. Creed enjoys walks, runs, games of fetch, squeaky toys, and chewing on bones. He also knows basic commands like “sit” and “stay,” and his intelligence makes him eager to engage and interact.


Creed would do great in a house and has also done well in an apartment setting!


At home, Creed is house-trained, comfortable relaxing on his dog bed, and does well being left alone for moderate periods of time. He is crate trained. He allows handling for baths and general care, and overall is a very loving, family-oriented dog.


Creed is looking for a stable, loving forever home where he can be an adored companion, exercise buddy, and best friend. If you’re looking for a sweet, intelligent dog with a big heart and lots of personality, Creed may be your perfect match.


Creed is neutered, heart worm negative, and ready to go home today!

name: Carmelo
description_html: Carmelo is such a happy go lucky guy! He loves to be petted and talked to, he loves treats, and he loves to play. He would fit into so many types of homes. He's a really gentle, sweet guy that loves everyone he meets and is dog social, too! He'd love to find a home asap to get some "meat on his bones" as they say - this guy is just too thin! We hope you can come meet this super sweetheart Carmelo asap.

name: Gypsy
description_html:
Gypsy is a polite little lady with lovely manners and a steady, easygoing nature. She is a great cuddle buddy in the most relaxing and sweet way. She’s wonderfully house trained, knows when it’s potty time, and enjoys following her nose through the grass like a tiny explorer on a mission. She loves to collect toys and will join in on a dance when the music comes on. After a long day of fun adventure, she likes to sit back down, kick her feet up, and relax, making her a great friend to decompress with.

Gypsy can be a bit particular about her doggy friends, but she handles those moments with grace and tolerance.

Looking for a sweet soul with a whole lot of heart? Come meet Gypsy and let her charm her way right into your life!

Gypsy's short-term foster shared: "Gypsy is the sweetest girl! She will calmly cuddle and watch tv but also loves to play fetch. She is great on walks and is housebroken. She's not a big barker unless she sees a squirrel or a stranger enters the house. She is quick to become a friend to anyone she meets – she loves humans. She will be a great addition to your home!"

name: Miss Pretty
description_html:
Happy is as happy does and Miss Pretty is a happy girl. who can be a little shy at first. She's worth the meet. You'll soon be on her friend's list. Ask staff to get her out, or if offsite, arrange a meet up with her advocates at caring@classiccanines.org. Need a meet up with a dog? No problem.

Miss Pretty has so much to offer:

--She'll never turn down a treat

--She loves comforts and is non-destructive

--She's very house trained , she's also crate trained

--She walks nicely on a leash, not bothered by other dogs

--Her favorite activities: window watching & extraordinary sniff walk skills

--Also a pro at riding in the car

--Perfect companionship

name: Opie
description_html:
Meet Opie 💚

Opie is a happy, social boy who’s been making lots of friends lately—and winning hearts wherever he goes! He’s shown himself to be comfortable with new people, with no signs of shyness or sensitivity to touch. He’s just an easygoing, friendly pup who enjoys being around others.

Opie really lights up when he’s out of his kennel. Whether he’s heading out for a walk (where he does great on leash) or enjoying playtime in the yard with his favorite toys, he’s all about having fun and soaking up the moment.

In our short times in a mock living room, Opie has been a wonderful guest—non-destructive, curious, and eager to explore his surroundings. He especially loved lounging on the couch and trying to take in the view from the window, showing off his relaxed and cozy side.

With his combination of playful energy and laid-back charm, Opie is ready to fit right into a home where he can keep making friends, enjoying toys, and sharing plenty of happy moments.

name: Gatito
description_html:
Gatito is pure enthusiasm in dog form — and he's looking for someone who's ready to grow with him. Full of energy, affection, and a whole lot of heart, this puppy is at his happiest when he's soaking up

attention and love from the people around him. He thrives on connection and will repay every pet and scratch with total devotion.


Gatito already knows "sit" — a great foundation for a pup with his drive to please. He's highly motivated, which makes training sessions fun and productive. On the leash he's a work in progress: some moments he's striding alongside you nicely, others he's off to the races with

a classic case of the zoomies. With consistent practice and patience, he's going to be a stellar walking companion.


At home, Gatito is cuddly and warm — all that big energy melts right into snuggle mode when it counts. He'd do best in an active household ready to invest in his training and channel his spark in the right direction. The effort will pay off tenfold.


Come by, he's ready to go home today! If you have any questions, please reach out to orangedotcrew@gmail.com

name: Pixie
description_html:
Pixie is a small bundle of sweetness looking for a cozy place to call home. This quiet, gentle girl is already showing how quickly she learns—she’s doing great practicing her leash walking and improving every day.


Pixie has a calm, easygoing personality and absolutely loves being close to her people. She happily allows nail trims and handles gentle care like a champ, showing just how trusting and well-mannered she is.


Her favorite thing in the world? Snuggling. Pixie would be thrilled to curl up beside you—or even better, right in your lap—for some quality cuddle time. If you’re looking for a soft-hearted companion who will happily keep you company and shower you with quiet affection, Pixie might be the perfect match.

name: Moose
description_html: Meet Moose, a two-year-old gray brindle pitbull with a zest for life that's contagious! Moose is the kind of dog who finds joy in everything—especially his toys, which he absolutely adores. Moose is sweet to his core and already knows "sit," showing he's eager to learn and please the people he loves. An active family or individual who enjoys playtime, training, and maybe a game of fetch will find in Moose not just an energetic sidekick, but a loyal, affectionate friend ready to make every day a little more fun.

name: Mojito
description_html: Look at that face! Meet Mojito, a splash of pure joy looking for his forever home. This striking boy instantly grabs your attention with his unique, captivating eyes—one beautiful blue, one warm brown. But it’s his massive, goofy smile and floppy ears that will truly steal your heart. Mojito is the ultimate enthusiast; he loves exploring the outdoors, leaning in close for affection, and flashing his signature grin for the camera. He’s a happy, active companion who brings bright, sunny energy wherever he goes. Ready to add a little extra flavor and endless love to your life? Mojito is your boy!

name: Maxine
description_html:
Maxine = Perfection!


Hi! I am Maxine. I thought I would take the time to write my bio, since I am looking for my forever home - even though I love my current house with my big Boxer sister. I want to start off by saying I love the company of other dogs! I don’t know if I have been around cats before, so I cannot tell you if I get along with them or not. I am super friendly and have very good manners when I am playing. You’d think since I am so young that I would have endless energy, but I actually like lounging around – preferably sitting in your lap, chewing on my bones, or sunbathing outside. That is not to say I don’t play – check me out on my profile videos - but I am mostly very laid back. That is…until you mention “walk”. I cannot contain myself! I run around, grab my toys, run into my fur sister, grab my mom’s shoe, and spin around. Now, I do calm down once we actually get to the door, but until then, I am just so excited! If you like easy walkers, then I am your girl. I am a very loose leash walker and not reactive to other dogs. But, those little lizards….that’s another story! If I do see one, all you have to do is say my name and I refocus and leave them alone - just be sure to hold tight to my leash!

I love my squeaky toys, treats, and water! I am a total water baby. My foster mom bought me a pool and I love it – if you don’t believe me – check out the video of me in my pool! I am extremely house trained and to this day have not torn anything up – including my toys! I am a very quick learner and very polite! I am not a frequent barker, don’t seem to show any signs of separation anxiety, and loud noises don’t seem to bother me. Really, no red flags at all, which means that I am the perfect pup for you!

I do take a little bit of time to warm up to people, especially if it is more than one person at a time. So any introduction needs to be slow and I need to be given enough space to feel everything out. But, once I am all warmed up, be prepared for me to sit perched in your lap! Treats are a pretty good motivator to warm me up as well!

Let me know if you would like to meet up! 


When she was in the shelter, she was a volunteer favorite, and her friends try to get all the other volunteers to meet her because "everyone should get to experience the absolute sweet, gentle, and kind love that will melt your heart from this girl".


Maxine is spayed, heartworm negative, and ready for adoption today!

name: Nicholas
description_html:
Nicholas is a handsome pup whose striking black-and-white tuxedo markings—complete with the cutest freckles—are perfectly matched by his dapper and polite personality. As you can see from his bright, happy gaze and ready-for-action grin, he is a cheerful bundle of playfulness and affection. Nicholas is the ultimate social butterfly; he is incredibly loving and forms instant bonds with every human he meets. 

True to his lively nature, Nicholas’s favorite time is playtime. He's an expert-level toy enthusiast and has never met a squeaky toy or ball he didn't adore. While he has plenty of playful energy, he’s also a gentleman on outdoor adventures, handling nicely on a leash. 

If you are looking for a playful, loving, and well-mannered companion to bring endless joy to your home, this tuxedo-clad charm is waiting for you!

name: Rascal
description_html:
Meet Rascal—your future 60-pound lap dog!


Rascal is ready to leave his past behind and start the next chapter of his life with a loving forever family. This handsome boy is as easy going as they come and has quickly become a volunteer favorite.


Rascal walks beautifully on leash and enjoys relaxed strolls where he can take in the world by your side. He’s a loose-leash walker who makes walks a breeze. While he enjoys getting out and about, what Rascal really loves most is simply being near his people.


With his calm, even-keeled personality and affectionate nature, Rascal is the kind of dog who fits right in and makes every day a little brighter. And did we mention how handsome he is?


Rascal can’t wait to meet his forever family - maybe that’s you!

name: Velveteen
description_html:
Meet Velveteen ~

Here is the sweetest, gentlest, quietest lady in the room. She has distinctive features like a bunny hop in her trot, and no tail, earning her a sweet rabbit tale name. She loves to quietly watch life unfold, from a window view, or a patio.

Velveteen is a very smart and food motivated pup, eager to follow instructions for a tasty treat. She knows “sit”, “paw”, “other paw” , and “lie down”. There’s nothing Velveteen loves more than snuggling up to her person, and as the ultimate cuddle bug she would do best in a home where she can always be around her human companion. She loves to go for car rides, is house trained, crate trained, very well behaved in the bath, and butter smooth on a leash. Though her little hippity hop limits the distance she can walk, it doesn’t stop her from enjoying her time outside! She's a great compact size, and combined with her good manners, she makes an easy fit in many home environments. She shares her space nicely with a large lady senior dog friend and though she is wary of cats, she shows interest in meeting new pups. With proper introductions and consistent interactions she’ll have the confidence to make new canine friends.

She's spayed, vaccinated, heart worm negative and has had recent bloodwork completed.

Velveteen has an advocacy group of volunteers - if you have questions, write us at caring@classiccanines.org

name: Baby Acorn
description_html: She would do best in a home with one or more dogs as she seems to thrive with other dogs. She’s a tad nervous of the world, so having other confident dogs around her helps her not feel like the world is too scary! She’s loves to swim, snuggle and play with her foster brother. She does well in the crate, no issues! She takes a bit of time to trust and warm up to her humans, but once she does, she’s very affectionate and sweet. She doesn’t have a mean bone in her body! She also loves to fetch 💕

name: Bobby
description_html:
Big Boy Bobby - Bobby for short - has never met a ball or person he doesn't like. Bobby is dog-social, sweet, and so very handsome. He'd love to play fetch with his new people, and wouldn't mind a well-matched dog sibling. At the very least, please bring him a home with a lot of balls - his very, very favorite - he will love to prance by you showing off his ball, wiggling his entire body, and then drop his ball and roll on top of it he's just that excited!


Come meet this big-headed, bigger-hearted guy asap - he's waiting for you!

name: Princess
description_html: This sweet, one-year-old girl is smart, loyal, energetic, affectionate, and goofy. She LOVES food and toys and enjoys playing with other dogs. She responds well to training and redirection. She is a very happy dog, and zoomies will occur once she feels safe with her family and in her environment. She is housebroken and sleeps well in her crate. She is a velcro dog who will curl up beside you and snuggle. By the way, she is almost 45 lbs now (not 36 lbs as the shelter indicates).

name: Marcus
description_html:
Marcus is a full-of-life, playful dog who approaches every activity with enthusiasm! His favorite things include fetch, tug-of-war, walks, squeaky toys, and chewing on bones. He already knows 'sit' and would love a family ready to channel his joyful energy into games, adventures, and positive training.


Marcus has wonderful family experience. He previously lived with children ages two and four, and his former family described him as friendly with both adults and children—including people he had never met before. He is still learning to handle his big feelings when excited, so continued work on calm greetings and appropriate play will help him become an even more polished companion.


Marcus also has promising dog experience. During his first shelter playgroup, he also offered nice greetings, warmed up quickly, and enjoyed chase play and zoomies with another dog. He lives with a doggy roommate at the shelter and would likely do well in a multi-dog household. Ask shelter staff about scheduling a meet-and-greet with your resident dogs to make sure it’s a good fit!


Marcus is a young puppy and still working on house-training, leash manners, and feeling comfortable when left alone. He will benefit from structure, enrichment, exercise, and lots of treats and praise for good behavior!


For an active family looking for a cheerful, exuberant companion with plenty of personality, Marcus could be exactly the dog they have been waiting for. Come meet him today!

name: Babushka
description_html: Babushka is a precious little pocket pittie. She may be a little shy at first but soon warms up. Babushka is quiet in her kennel, walks easily on leash and calmly passes barking dogs. In the play yard, she enjoys exploring and checking out a few toys. This sweet young girl especially likes to be close to her person and loves cuddling. She is ready to find her forever home and become a cherished companion. Come meet Babushka and fall in love. ❤️

name: Cheyenne
description_html:
Cheyenne is a character with a heart of gold! At about a year old, this affectionate girl is the definition of a "lovebug" who lives for snuggles, playtime, and her favorite: Balls! She is a pro at fetch (she’ll even bounce the ball for herself) and loves having space to let her puppy energy (and zoomies!) out.


She’s a smart girl who is eager to learn and has shown great progress with training. While she might be a bit shy with men when first meeting, she is quick to warm up with proper, gentle, and patient introductions. Cheyenne is well-socialized with other dogs and has done well with older children. She’s a fantastic quiet companion for the home, crate-trained, house-trained, and ready to be your dedicated family member today!

name: Bolt
description_html:
Meet Bolt: a happy, silly, and playful boy who’s discovering just how wonderful the world can be.

Bolt loves spending time with his people and finds comfort simply being by your side. He’s always up for a great game of fetch and would make an amazing adventure buddy.

After a day of fun, Bolt is just as happy to settle in and show his affectionate side. He has so much love to give and enjoys being close to the people he trusts. He’s also very house-trained, making him an easy addition to a home.

With his unique personality and joyful spirit, Bolt truly is a special dog. All he needs now is a forever family to share life’s adventures with.

Could that be you?

--

name: Lucy
description_html:
Lucy is the kind of dog who makes you earn her trust—and then rewards you tenfold. ❤️


This gorgeous heeler mix can be a little shy when meeting new people and may take some time to warm up. But with a little patience, you'll discover a loving, loyal girl who thinks her favorite humans are the greatest people on earth.


Once you're in Lucy's circle, she's a total velcro dog. She loves snuggles, showering you with kisses, gently pawing for attention, and tagging along wherever you go. She's happiest enjoying a good sniffy walk, soaking up life's simple pleasures, and spending time with her people.


And when she's feeling extra happy? Lucy breaks out into the cutest zippy zoomies around the yard that are guaranteed to make you smile. She's also a fantastic size—not too big, not too small—making her an easy companion for all kinds of adventures.


If you're willing to give her a chance to come out of her shell, Lucy will be the kind of companion who loves you with her whole heart. She's absolutely worth the wait.

name: Molly
description_html:
***Molly is currently available for adoption in the Boulder/Denver CO area***

Meet Molly!

This incredibly sweet, gentle girl is an absolute breeze. Molly is the most mild mannered, easy girl you'll ever meet. She's perfectly house trained, walks calmly on a leash, and sleeps through the night without a peep. She's crate trained, takes treats gently from your hand, and naps while you're away at work or running errands.

Molly loves other dogs and would be happy to have a canine companion in her forever home. Molly's goofy side comes out when she first goes outside in the morning and rolls around in the grass filled with joy. She also loves a good play session with her dog friends. While Molly is independent, she also really enjoys being pet and makes the cutest little whines when she's getting good scritches. She'll lean into you and might even somersault into your lap for a snuggle.

Molly would make the most wonderful family dog and could fit into most any home. Click the "get started" button to be connected to Molly's foster and learn more about this amazing girl!

name: Bruce
description_html:
Meet Bruce!


Bruce is a 4-year-old sweetheart with a playful spirit and a lot of love to give. This handsome boy enjoys tug-of-war, wrestling, and going on walks, and he absolutely thrives on human attention and affection. Once he trusts you, Bruce is incredibly loving, loyal, and eager to be close to his people.

Bruce has had a difficult and unstable start in life, but despite that, he remains a sweet and gentle dog at heart.


He is house-trained, enjoys spending time outdoors, and has been described as loving, playful, and “a sweetie deep down.” Bruce also understands some Spanish along with English!


Bruce would do best in a stable home with patient adopters and plenty of opportunities for exercise and companionship. He has spent much of his time outside and alone, so he deserves a family who can help him feel safe, included, and cared for.


Bruce is ready for a fresh start and a forever home where he can finally relax, learn, and be loved the way every dog deserves.


Bruce is neutered, heart worm negative, and ready to leave the shelter today!

name: Bee
description_html:
Bee is very sweet, but she’s also very shy with people. She was brought to AAS from the community, and during her spay surgery, the DVM found mucosa of bladder to be protruding cranially, so the tissue was resected. She moved into foster care to recover and to be monitored. The results of several ultrasounds indicate that her bladder has healed completely. Her urinary habits are normal at this time.

As a member of our Cactus Cats program, Bee is becoming more comfortable with humans. She tends to hide, but likes to be petted. She is not aggressive, she’s just learning to appreciate all the things that people are good for.

Bee will do best in a home with a cat buddy. She was friends with Cassia in their foster home.

I am a DHC, and I have my own webpage!

The adoption fee is waived for Bee and ALL Desperate Housecats/Cactus Cats!

name: Milo
description_html:
Milo was once lost but now has found a temporary home through the shelter in the comforts of a foster home. He's calm and friendly, sweet and affectionate, has nice leash manners and allows the nearby deer to be undisturbed. He's at peace with nature's creatures.


This easy relaxing boy has not a care in the world. He enjoys simple companionship and having a cozy blanket to curl up on. His motto.... "Life is good". He loves people and welcomes in all the friends and family and he's so silky soft and cuddly! He travels great for road trips, has stayed in tents while camping, and in hotel rooms, and he's as quiet as a church mouse. He often even puts himself to bed when he's tired. Enjoy his beach photos. The point is, Milo is happy wherever you want to be, whether on land, near the water, or excursions in between. And when you have to be away a few hours, he'll take care of himself, and welcome you upon your return.

Connect with his foster at his link to meet up with this very special gentleman.

name: Strudel
description_html: Strudel came in with several other cats from a difficult situation. Despite this, she's affectionate and learning to be braver each day. She may be found in a hiding spot, but she will gladly accept pets and ask for more if you are patient with her. She loves Churu so that may be a great way to make friends. Strudel may enjoy a friendly cat companion in her new home or the company of one of her mates.

name: Billie
description_html:
Billie is a sweet, loyal girl who has blossomed beautifully in foster care. While she may be a little shy when meeting new people, all she really needs is a little patience, a few treats, and some time to realize you’re a friend. Once she trusts you, Billie becomes the ultimate companion—following you from room to room, curling up beside you at bedtime, and filling your days with unconditional love.


At a svelte 37 pounds, she’s the perfect size for a home or an apartment. 


Billie has been living with another dog in her foster home and has been an excellent canine companion. She loves to play, wrestle, chase, and be chased, and she’s happy to share toys and engage in friendly games of tug-of-war. She would likely thrive in a home with another playful dog, but she would also be perfectly happy as your one-and-only best friend.


An active girl, Billie enjoys daily walks and outdoor adventures. She’s wonderful on leash, enjoys exploring the neighborhood, and rides beautifully in the car. One of her favorite car ride habits is resting her head on her person’s arm while watching the world go by—a guaranteed heart-melter.


Billie is house-trained, non-destructive, and has proven she can be trusted at home while her people are away. She’s eager to please, highly treat-motivated, and continues to gain confidence every day. While she may bark briefly when visitors arrive, she settles quickly and warms up even faster when treats are involved. Especially CHEESE!


Billie loves activity and engagement, but is content to curl up under the desk and snooze as her person works. She’d do best with a family that can provide regular exercise, playtime, and companionship. She has lots of energy for fun but an equally impressive capacity for snuggles once the day is done.


The best thing about Billie is her heart. Beneath her initially cautious exterior is an incredibly loving, devoted dog who forms deep bonds with her people. If you’re willing to give her a little time to settle in, she’ll reward you with a lifetime of loyalty, affection, and companionship.


Billie is ready to find the forever home she deserves. Could that be with you?

name: Butters
description_html:
Butters arrived with an active much smaller sized dog friend who since found a new home. Butters is waiting for his next adventure in life while sharing his kennel space with another large dog. He loves being part of all the activity going on inside and out, and seems perfectly suited for an active lifestyle. He's not ready to slow down any time soon. He'll charm you to the moon and back, along with all your friends too as a great house and walk companion.


Butters and his original doggie accomplice had a mishap with chickens before arriving to the shelter. Expect that Butters may treat small mammals as prey or sport and his home should have a well secured fence.


Check out his Instagram account HERE!

name: Clove
description_html: Clove is one of many cats who were found abandoned in a residence. He is shy and unsure of the shelter, which is completely natural given all that he's been through. Clove and all of his feline friends may need some reassurance in a new place and some time to get used to new people. They are all looking for a loving home where they can relax and show their true personalities.

name: Chili
description_html: Chili is one of many cats who were found abandoned in a residence. She is shy and unsure of the shelter, which is completely natural given all that he's been through. Chili and all of her feline friends may need some reassurance in a new place and some time to get used to new people. They are all looking for a loving home where they can relax and show their true personalities. They may do well in a space with other cats or can go home together.

name: Simba
description_html: Simba is a graduate of our Enduring Service program! To learn more about this program, read about it on our website. According to his Enduring Service program handlers, Simba is a smart and beautiful puppy. Can be a little shy at first but once he gains your trust he loves to play and get all the attention. Has great leash skills and listens very well. Is treat motivated and a fast learner. He is well behaved when it's bath time, loves getting in the water. His favorite game to play is tug-of-war. Listens very well when being told to drop things he should not have. Gets along well with other dogs so could go home with a well-matched companion. He knows commands such as sit, stay, down, off, drop it, paw and roll over. Simba would make a great addition to any family

name: Leo
description_html:
Meet Leo — the dog who woke up looking like he already nailed his eyeliner.

Seriously, we don’t know how he does it. No smudges, no effort, just natural, bold, “I’m-ready-for-my-close-up” eyes that turn heads everywhere he goes. But Leo isn’t just a pretty face (though… wow, yeah, he really is).

Leo is young, happy, very house trained, and completely tuned in to people. He loves being around you, whether that means heading out for a walk, hopping in the car like a seasoned road trip buddy, or just leaning into you for pets like it’s his full-time job. Treats? Obviously yes. Attention? Even better.

Leo is just a genuinely good dog who seems ready to slide right into someone’s life and make it better.

If you’ve been waiting for a sign… this is Leo, blinking at you with perfect eyeliner and a handsome face.

Email his volunteer advocates at orangedotcrew@gmail.com to meet him. He’s ready when you are.

name: Kya
description_html:
Kya is a sweet, playful companion who loves walks and loves to be interactive with people - she's part diva and part funny ham.

She's still learning the ropes of being in a busy, very public kennel building- it can be downright scary for new arriving dogs, so if she steps outside for a moment when you're near, don't take offense-ask for help to meet her instead and you'll get to meet the real Kya, plus maybe you've save her the expense of having to endure more time in a shelter.
